title: QA/RA Engineer – Medical Devices (MDR)
description:
Copenhagen area, Denmark (Industrivej 12, 3540 Lynge). Hybrid: remote work with on-site visits to Valcon typically once or twice a month. Candidates based elsewhere in the EU are welcome to apply. Application deadline: 30 October 2026. We are hiring as soon as possible, so applications are reviewed as received and the posting may close earlier once the position is filled.

Do you have solid experience with quality assurance and regulatory affairs for medical devices under EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016, and are you motivated by the opportunity to build a QA/RA function from the ground up?

Would you like to take ownership of technical documentation, risk management, and Notified Body compliance for a growing medical device portfolio?

Then you might be our new QA/RA Engineer.

About Valcon Medical

Valcon Medical A/S manufactures medical cannabis extracts and cannabis oils for the Danish market and a number of export markets. We are approved by the Danish Medicines Agency to manufacture medical cannabis in accordance with EU-GMP and applicable Danish legislation on medical cannabis.

We are a company in development, with new products, processes, and technologies entering the organization, including an expanding medical device portfolio. This role is being established to build our QA/RA function for compliance with EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016, and to ensure our device documentation and processes meet Notified Body and Competent Authority expectations.

You will work closely with colleagues across Quality, R&D, Manufacturing, and Clinical Affairs. As a smaller company, we have short decision-making paths, and the QA/RA function works closely with the rest of the organization. You will therefore have the opportunity to work with both classic QA/RA tasks and take responsibility for new issues, where you will independently investigate, assess, and help find the right solution, including shaping how our MDR compliance function is built from an early stage.

Areas of responsibility for the QA/RA function

  • Implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System in compliance with ISO 13485:2016 and EU MDR 2017/745

  • Maintain current knowledge of EU MDR 2017/745, ISO 13485:2016, and relevant harmonised standards, and advise the organization on compliance matters

  • Preparation and maintenance of Technical Documentation (MDR Annex II/III), including GSPR checklist (Annex I) traceability to design and verification/validation evidence

  • Document Control as a core, ongoing function: creation, revision, review/approval routing, distribution, and archival of controlled documents and records (ISO 13485:2016 Clauses 4.2.4/4.2.5)

  • Change Control: assessment and impact evaluation across design, risk, and regulatory documentation, and approval routing for design, process, and document changes

  • Risk management (ISO 14971) throughout the product lifecycle, including FMEA documentation and risk control/mitigation measures

  • Review and approval of verification and validation protocols and reports, and support for validation of processes, software, and equipment (e.g. IEC 62304, as applicable to the product)

  • Preparation and review of CAPAs and nonconformance reports

  • Supplier qualification and ongoing oversight of critical suppliers, including Quality Assurance Agreements (ISO 13485:2016 Clauses 4.1.5 and 7.4)

  • Conduct supplier audits and support Notified Body audits under the MDR Annex IX conformity assessment procedure

  • Post-Market Surveillance per MDR Articles 83–86, including complaint handling, PMS reporting, and PMCF as applicable

  • Vigilance reporting to Competent Authorities per MDR Articles 87–92, including serious incident reporting and Field Safety Corrective Actions

  • UDI assignment and EUDAMED registration activities (Basic UDI-DI, UDI-DI, device and certificate registration)

  • Clinical Evaluation Report maintenance per MDR Article 61 / Annex XIV, in coordination with Clinical Affairs, where applicable

  • Collaborate with R&D, Manufacturing, and Clinical Affairs to embed GSPR (Annex I) and Design Control (ISO 13485:2016 Clause 7.3) requirements into product development and production

  • Provide training to employees on QMS requirements, EU MDR obligations, and risk-management practices

  • Provide input on EU regulatory submissions and CE-marking compliance strategy, including engagement with Notified Bodies

Your qualifications and experience

We envision that you have:

  • A bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field

  • A minimum of 2–5 years of experience in QA/RA roles within the medical device industry, working under EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016

  • Hands-on working experience inside a live, certified ISO 13485:2016 Quality Management System, not solely academic or classroom knowledge of the standard

  • Direct, hands-on experience operating within core QMS processes: Supplier Control, Document Control, Change Control, Complaint Handling, and CAPA

  • Working knowledge of ISO 13485:2016 and EU MDR 2017/745, and of relevant harmonised standards (e.g. ISO 14971, IEC 62366-1, IEC 60601 series, IEC 62304 as applicable to the product)

  • Demonstrated, hands-on authorship or maintenance experience with EU MDR Technical Documentation (Annex II/III), including GSPR checklist mapping and design/verification/validation evidence linkage. General familiarity with the standard is not sufficient

  • Ability to interpret and apply EU regulatory requirements effectively, including direct engagement with Notified Bodies

  • Fluent English, written and spoken, for Notified Body and international supplier communication

It is an advantage, but not a requirement, to have experience with one or more of the following areas:

  • EUDAMED, the UDI system, and Basic UDI-DI concepts

  • EU GMP requirements, given Valcon's GMP-regulated production environment

  • Danish language skills

Your competencies

  • Works in a structured and systematic manner, with a focus on completing tasks

  • Able to work independently, take responsibility for own tasks, and drive projects forward

  • Strong grasp of risk management (ISO 14971) and verification/validation principles

  • Enjoys a mix of technical assessment, practical problem-solving, and documentation work

  • Is proactive, solution-oriented, and contributes positively to collaboration with colleagues

  • Competencies in data processing and report writing

What we offer

You will have a broad and independent role in a company in development, where you will help build our medical device QA/RA function from an early stage and work closely with production, product development, and the company's other activities.

As part of a smaller organization, you will have short decision-making paths, extensive insight across the company, and the opportunity to have real influence on both your own areas of responsibility and the development of our QA/RA function.

For the right person, there are good opportunities to develop the role as the company grows and to take responsibility for new subject areas and projects.

This is a hybrid role. Most of the work can be done remotely, and we expect you on site at our facility in Lynge, north of Copenhagen, typically once or twice a month. Expect more frequent presence during onboarding and around Notified Body and supplier audits. [Travel costs to Valcon are covered by the company.]

How to apply

The position is based in our QA/RA function. If you would like to hear more about the job, please contact Chanel La (cl@valcon-medical.com)

Please send your CV to job@valcon-medical.com. In your application, please include 3–4 sentences on a Technical Documentation or CAPA process you personally owned under a certified ISO 13485 QMS: what you did and what the outcome was.

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Senior Automation Engineer, DK - Esbjerg
description:
Do you want to develop advanced automation solutions for critical energy and marine infrastructure?

As a Senior Automation Engineer at Semco Maritime, you will join our Automation & Electrical team, working with complex control systems for energy facilities, marine installations and offshore platforms.

You will take technical ownership of automation solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from functional design and software development to commissioning, troubleshooting and lifecycle support. You will also contribute to the continued development of our technical standards and provide professional guidance to colleagues and project teams.

The role includes opportunities to work with advanced drive and motor-control solutions, including commissioning, troubleshooting and retrofit activities involving Danfoss VLT and VACON products.

At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value. In this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering reliable and pragmatic solutions for critical installations.

Your place of work will be our Global Headquarters in Esbjerg, located at the heart of the Danish energy industry and directly on the waterfront. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 10–30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

You will work across the full project lifecycle in close collaboration with project managers, electrical designers, customers and other technical specialists.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Taking technical ownership of automation solutions and defining system architecture, interfaces and software structures.
  • Designing and developing PLC software, functional descriptions and structured code for complex marine, offshore and energy systems.
  • Developing automation solutions for BMS, PMS and hybrid energy systems, including ESS, shore power and generator control.
  • Integrating, configuring and commissioning variable-frequency drives and motor and pump-control systems, including various solutions.
  • Performing network and system integration across automation, electrical and third-party systems.
  • Conducting FAT, SAT and commissioning activities both onshore and offshore.
  • Troubleshooting live systems and resolving complex technical issues on critical installations.
  • Reviewing and quality-assuring automation designs, software and technical documentation.
  • Supporting and mentoring less experienced engineers and contributing to the development of internal standards and best practices.
  • Maintaining close technical dialogue with project management, customers, suppliers and other engineering disciplines.


Your profile & qualifications

You have a technical background in automation, electrical engineering or mechatronics and solid experience from the energy, power generation, oil and gas, offshore wind or maritime industries.

You are comfortable working with complex systems where safety, reliability and uptime are essential. You approach your responsibilities proactively, communicate clearly and are capable of taking technical ownership while remaining a strong team player.

We expect that you:

  • Have at least five years of experience with PLC programming in Siemens TIA Portal, preferably using SCL.
  • Have experience developing automation solutions for energy, marine or offshore applications.
  • Have a strong understanding of automation architecture, industrial networks and protocols such as Profinet, Modbus TCP and CAN/J1939.
  • Have knowledge of energy systems, power management or hybrid solutions such as ESS and shore power.
  • Have experience with variable-frequency drives, motor control and commissioning. Experience with Danfoss VLT or VACON products will be considered an advantage.
  • Can translate functional and operational requirements into scalable, structured and well-documented software.
  • Are capable of reviewing technical solutions and guiding colleagues on complex automation-related matters.
  • Thrive in a project-driven environment with close interdisciplinary collaboration and customer interaction.
  • Are willing to participate in commissioning and service assignments both onshore and offshore.
  • Are professionally fluent in English. Danish language skills will be considered an advantage.


Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

description:
Operations and technicians

Teamlead Reliability Engineers

Imagine a future where you lead an international engineering team that improves the safety, reliability, and performance of our wind farms.Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms. Welcome to Generation CE You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions. As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work. You’ll play an important role in: leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements. To succeed in the role, you: have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English. Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate. As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com (accommodation@orsted.com) . Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position. Position salary range: For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.Pre-employment background checks:For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

title: Mecánico / Service Technician - Relocation - Northen Europe
description:
What to Expect

Join Tesla: Bring Your Skills to Northern Europe

Do you want to help build a world of amazing abundance? At Tesla, that’s our mission.

We’ve created one of the most innovative vehicles ever made and as a Service Technician, you’ll help deliver an equally groundbreaking service experience to our customers.

Are you ready to take on the challenge and make a real impact in one of the world’s most sustainable and tech-forward regions? We have open roles across Northen Europe.

Why Move to Northen Europe? 

Relocating to Europe isn’t just a career move, it’s a life upgrade. Here’s what you gain:

  • Top-Tier Quality of Life: Consistently ranked among the happiest and safest countries in the world, clean air, green spaces, and safe cities.

  • Sustainable Living: Live in a country where EVs are the norm, public transport is excellent, and sustainability is woven into daily life.

  • Strong Tech & Innovation Ecosystems: Work at the heart of Europe’s clean energy and tech revolution, with access to cutting-edge tools, R&D and global collaboration.

What You’ll Do

Your Role: Service Technician at Tesla

  • Service, repair and improve: Use Tesla-specific software and advanced diagnostic tools to maintain and repair all Tesla vehicles.

  • Ensure top quality: Fix it right the first time. You’ll inspect vehicles with care before return and pre-delivery, because excellence is non-negotiable.

  • Collaborate ,across teams: Work with local and regional colleagues to share knowledge, solve complex issues, and continuously improve the service experience.

  • Grow with us: Access ongoing training, hands-on workshops, and a blended learning program to develop your technical and leadership skills. Your expertise helps shape the future of Tesla service.

What You’ll Bring

 We’re Looking For:

  • Technically experienced: Proven background in vehicle service, repair, or maintenance - automotive, aviation, marine, or industrial.

  • Team player: You thrive in diverse, collaborative environments and value shared success.

  • Flexible & adaptable: Comfortable working in shifts and across time zones to support global operations.

  • Clear communicator: Fluent in English (written and spoken), with the ability to explain technical issues clearly and respectfully.

  • Safe to drive: Valid driver’s license required (for test drives and vehicle handling).

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits

  • A workplace that values you: Safe, clean, innovative, and fun, where your voice matters and your growth is prioritized.

This Is More Than a Job. It’s a Move to the Future.

If you're a skilled technician ready to bring your expertise to a place where sustainability, innovation, and quality of life go hand in hand, apply now.

Join Tesla. Build the future. Live the future.

Kui oled meeskonnamängija, siis see üldsegi mitte igav ja mitmekülgne töö võib olla just Sulle! Me ei eelda, et Sa oskad kõike. Kui Sul on suur huvi rasketehnika ja metallitööde vastu, siis see on juba kõige olulisem. Kuulutuses märgitud palk ei ole ülempiir- see on meie miinimum. Initsiatiiv+motivatsioon+tööde teostamise kiirus= kõrgem palk! Kui soovid täpsemat tööde kirjeldust, siis helista või tule kohale meiega tutvuma!

title: Rendi projektijuht
description:
Tööülesanded: Otsime oma meeskonda rendi projektijuhti. Sa ei tee seda üksi — Sinu selja taga on kogenud Storenti meeskond ja väljakujunenud protsessid — kuid Tallinnas oled just Sina see, kes klientide juures käib, projekte juhib ja piirkonna äri üles ehitab.
Usaldame Sulle: • Uute A-segmendi klientide leidmise ja Storenti tuntuse ülesehitamise Tallinna piirkonnas, • Pikaajaliste ja usalduslike kliendisuhete loomise ning hoidmise, • Rendiprojektide juhtimise algusest lõpuni — kliendi vajaduse mõistmisest kuni tehnika puhta tagastuseni, • Pakkumiste koostamise ja läbirääkimise õige hinnataseme ning kasumlikkuse eest, • Mugavat ja efektiivset projektide haldamist kaasaegses rendihaldussüsteemis.

Omalt poolt pakume: • Head töötasu - tagame väga head boonused. Mida rohkem kliente ja projekte, seda rohkem teenid.
• Tugevat meeskonda - pakume tööd professionaalses meeskonnas kaasaegse rendihaldussüsteemi toel. • Ärikoolitusi - pakume koolitusi tehnikapargile ning müügis. • Tööautot, mida tohib kasutada ka isiklikel sõitudel. • Paindlikku tööaega - võimalus kokku sobitada töö ja eraelu.

Muud nõuded: Vajalik on eelnev B2B tööriistade või ehitusseadmete ja -masinate edukas müügi või rendi kogemus.
Muud nõuded: B2B müügikogemus ja tulemustele orienteeritud isiksus, kes tunneb rõõmu nii diili sulgemisest kui pikaajalise kliendisuhte hoidmisest; • Ehitusvaldkonna ja sellel töötavate professionaalide tundmine — Sa tead, millest ehituse valdkonnas tegutseva kliendiga rääkida; • Iseseisvus, ettevõtja hoiak ja distsipliin; • B-kategooria juhiluba ja valmisolek piirkonnas regulaarselt külastada kliente ja ehitusobjekte; • Suhtled/kirjutad vabalt eesti keeles.

title: Assistant Manager
description:
.

Work tasks: Main Duties
• Prepare and cook a wide range of restaurant products, including savory and sweet dishes, baked products, pastries, dough products, fillings, sauces, soups, salads, desserts, and meat and fish dishes, according to established recipes and standards. • Prepare, roll, stretch, layer, fill, and handle dough and ensure consistent taste, texture, portioning, appearance, and presentation of finished products. • Organize and coordinate daily kitchen production, monitor product availability and workflow, adjust production when necessary, and maintain quality while minimizing waste. • Prepare and maintain the customer display/service line, including baking semi-ready products, arranging products, and ensuring appropriate availability, replenishment, presentation, and cleanliness. • Organize, coordinate, supervise, and control the daily operations of the restaurant-bakery, including customer service, kitchen and production activities, cleaning, storage, inventory, and overall operational readiness. • Prepare and coordinate daily, weekly, and monthly operational plans, including staffing, production, inventory, cleaning, maintenance, and other recurring requirements. • Monitor stock, ingredients, expiration dates, deliveries, inventory, write-offs, storage, and waste, and assist with ordering and stocktaking. • Maintain and ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, cleaning, allergen management, occupational safety, equipment, and workplace requirements. • Guide, supervise, train, and support cooks and other assigned employees; provide instructions and feedback, assess their job performance, coordinate their work and priorities, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed by assigned employees. • Communicate and coordinate effectively with servers, cleaners, management, suppliers, contractors, and other service providers to support smooth kitchen and restaurant operations. • Participate in and coordinate employee recruitment, including reviewing CVs and applications, communicating with candidates, conducting interviews, assessing candidates against position requirements, and supporting the selection of suitable employees. • Prepare and coordinate employee schedules, breaks, replacements, and staff deployment, adjusting staffing according to workload, absences, and operational requirements. • Monitor customer service and assist service staff when operationally necessary, particularly during busy periods, breaks, staff shortages, or absences. • Complete and monitor required production, inventory, cleaning, temperature, write-off, operational, and other records, checklists, documents, and reports. • Manage and participate in recipe implementation, menu and product development, testing, new-product introduction, and continuous improvement. • Identify operational or employee-performance deficiencies, take appropriate corrective action within assigned authority, and report significant issues to the Manager. • Take all appropriate actions and provide support the Manager in implementing operational decisions, procedures, standards, schedules, and plans and provide accurate information regarding restaurant operations. • Where specifically authorized and assigned in writing by the Employer, assume designated operational and supervisory responsibilities during the Manager’s absence.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Other requirements: • Previous experience in restaurant operations and staff supervision, including coordinating, guiding, and monitoring cooks, servers, cleaners, or other operational employees.
• Strong ability to organize daily operations, prioritize tasks, distribute work, monitor employee performance, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed. • Experience with staff scheduling, task allocation, production planning, inventory and stock control, ordering, receiving deliveries, stocktaking, write-offs, and waste control. • Strong customer-service and communication skills, including experience handling customer requests, complaints, order problems, and other service-related issues. • Good knowledge of food safety, hygiene, allergen management, cleanliness, occupational health and safety, and general restaurant operating requirements. • Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with employees, management, suppliers, contractors, technicians, and other service providers. • Good computer skills, including experience with POS and inventory systems, spreadsheets, email, scheduling, reporting, and basic business documentation. • Strong leadership, organizational, planning, communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage several priorities simultaneously. • Responsible, reliable, proactive, detail-oriented, trustworthy, and able to remain professional and solution-oriented during busy or challenging situations.

Option to work from home: No

Working load, shifts: 0.5 - 0.75

title: Kinnisvaramaakler
description:
Tööülesanded: 🏡Ootame oma meeskonda ambitsioonikat kinnisvaramaaklerit!
Kui Sul on kirg kinnisvara vastu ja soovid teha karjääri selles valdkonnas, siis pakume Sulle võimalust liituda meie meeskonnaga ning luua põnev ja mitmekülgne karjäär. Sinu tööülesanded saavad olema: 🤝 Kinnisvara üürijate, ostjate ja müüjatega suhtlemine 📈 Kinnisvara müügi- ja turundusplaani loomine 🔍 Turuanalüüside koostamine 🏢 Müügiklientidega kohtumine 📣 Kliendipäevade korraldamine 💼 Objektide turundamine 💬 Läbirääkimiste pidamine Ootame Sinu liitumist meie meeskonnaga, et koos saavutada suurepäraseid tulemusi!

Omalt poolt pakume: Innovaatilises ja arenevas ettevõttes ootab Sind töö sõbralikus meeskonnas!
🤝 Meie meeskond on avatud ja toetav, luues suurepärase töökeskkonna, kus saad oma oskusi täiendada ning ideid ellu viia. Meie jaoks on oluline, et iga töötaja tunneks end motiveerituna ja saaks oma potentsiaali maksimaalselt rakendada. 💰 Lisaks motiveerivale tasule pakume Sulle mentorprogrammi, kus saad kogenud juhendaja käe all õppida uusi teadmisi ja oskusi kinnisvaravaldkonnas. See programm aitab Sul kiiremini integreeruda meie meeskonnaga ning saada väärtuslikku karjäärinõu ja tuge. 🌟 Paindlikud tingimused on meie jaoks olulised. Mõistame, et tööelu ja isikliku elu tasakaal on oluline ning seetõttu oleme avatud aruteludele, et leida sobiv töögraafik ja tingimused, mis toetavad sinu parimaid võimalusi. 🏆 Lisaks korraldame müügivõistlusi, mis pakuvad Sulle võimalust end proovile panna ning saavutada suurepäraseid tulemusi. Meie meeskond aitab Sul seada selged eesmärgid ning toetab sind nende saavutamisel. 🎉 Lisaks tööle korraldame ka lahedaid üritusi, et meeskonnas oleks hea dünaamika ja koostöö. Saad osaleda erinevates meeskonnatöö tegevustes ja üritustel, mis aitavad luua tugevaid sidemeid kolleegidega.

Muud nõuded: Maakleritöös tuleb kasuks hea suhtlemisoskus, ettevõtlikkus ja tahe areneda.

title: Betoonitööde brigadir
description:
Otsime laialdase kogemusega brigadiri, kes meeskonna tööd juhiks platsil.

Tööülesanded: Tööde planeerimine ja juhtimine: Brigaadi igapäevatöö organiseerimine, ülesannete jagamine ja jooksvate probleemide lahendamine.
Kvaliteedi ja tehnoloogia kontroll: Raketiste paigalduse, armeerimise, betoneerimise ja betooni järelhoolduse vastavuse kontrollimine ehitusprojektile ning normidele. Tööohutuse tagamine: Ohutusnõuete täitmise jälgimine ehitusplatsil ja tellingutel. Materjalide ja tööriistade haldus: Vajalike materjalide (betoon, sarrused, raketised) ja seadmete õigeaegse olemasolu ning säästliku kasutamise tagamine. Aruandlus: Tehtud tööde mahu ja töötundide arvestuse pidamine ning info edastamine objektijuhile.

Omalt poolt pakume: Konkurentsivõimelist palka, mis vastab Sinu oskustele ja kogemustele
Alati õigeaegselt laekuvat töötasu ja ametlikku vormistamist. Stabiilset ja aastaringset tööd (meil on objektid olemas ka talveperioodil). Ametiautot või isikliku auto kompensatsiooni objektide vahel liikumiseks.Vajadusel tasuta majutust ja transporti ettevõtte poolt, kui objektid asuvad kodukohast kaugel. Võimalust rääkida kaasa tööprotsesside parendamisel ja meeskonna komplekteerimisel.

Muud nõuded: Vajalikud oskused ja omadused:
Erialane pädevus: Pikaajaline praktiline kogemus betoonitöödel (raketised, armatuur, valu, viimistlus) ja jooniste lugemise oskus. Juhtimisoskus: Võime meeskonda motiveerida, delegeerida ja konflikte lahendada. Pingetaluvus: Ehitusplatsil muutuvad olud kiiresti (ilmastik, tarneajad), mis nõuab kiiret reageerimist. Keeleoskus: lisaks eesti keelele ka vene keele oskus, et suhelda eri rahvusest töölistega.

description:
Work tasks: - Prepare a variety of dishes and baked goods according to established recipes and quality standards.
- Handle and prepare fresh ingredients, including meat, vegetables, and dough. - Ensure that all baked products meet established standards for quality, taste, and presentation. - Follow precise measurements and preparation techniques to maintain consistent product quality. - Monitor the baking process to achieve optimal results. - Maintain a clean, organized, and compliant kitchen environment while operating modern kitchen equipment efficiently. - Monitor inventory levels, assist with ordering supplies, ensure proper storage and labeling of ingredients, and minimize waste. - Ensure compliance with food safety and sanitation standards by conducting regular inspections of kitchen equipment, workspaces, and storage areas. - Effectively prioritize and manage multiple tasks, particularly during peak operating hours. - Adhere to work schedules and deadlines, ensuring that all products are prepared on time. - Collaborate with team members to ensure smooth kitchen operations and maintain a positive working environment. - Organize, coordinate, supervise, and oversee the daily operations of the restaurant-bakery, including customer service, kitchen and production activities, cleaning, storage, inventory management, and overall operational readiness. - Develop and coordinate daily, weekly, and monthly work plans covering staffing, production, inventory management, cleaning, maintenance, and other routine operational activities. - Communicate and collaborate effectively with service staff, cleaners, management, suppliers, contractors, and other service providers to ensure the smooth operation of the kitchen and restaurant. - Prepare and coordinate employee work schedules, breaks, replacements, and task assignments, adjusting staffing arrangements according to workload, employee absences, and operational needs. - Monitor customer service quality and assist service staff when necessary, particularly during peak hours, employee breaks, staff shortages, or employee absences.

We offer: - The opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly, supportive, and professional international team where every member’s contribution is valued. - Modern working conditions and professional equipment. - Competitive remuneration. - Opportunities for career advancement and personal development. - Affordable staff meals at our restaurant-bakery.

Other requirements: - Knowledge of baking techniques and current trends is an advantage.
- Strong attention to detail, reliability, excellent organizational skills, and commitment to maintaining hygiene and safety standards. - A positive, motivated, and cooperative attitude, with the ability to lead by example and maintain a positive working environment. - Leadership skills, including the ability to supervise and guide assistant cooks. - Passion for cooking and dedication to preparing high-quality food. - A valid health certificate for food handling. - Ability to work effectively under pressure and in a fast-paced environment. - Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and public holidays as required. Further details regarding the work schedule will be provided during the recruitment process. - Physical stamina to stand for extended periods and meet the demands of a busy restaurant-bakery environment.

description:
.

Work tasks: Main Duties

provide instructions and feedback, assess their job performance, coordinate their work and priorities, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed by assigned employees. • Communicate and coordinate effectively with servers, cleaners, management, suppliers, contractors, and other service providers to support smooth kitchen and restaurant operations. • Participate in and coordinate employee recruitment, including reviewing CVs and applications, communicating with candidates, conducting interviews, assessing candidates against position requirements, and supporting the selection of suitable employees. • Prepare and coordinate employee schedules, breaks, replacements, and staff deployment, adjusting staffing according to workload, absences, and operational requirements. • Monitor customer service and assist service staff when operationally necessary, particularly during busy periods, breaks, staff shortages, or absences. • Complete and monitor required production, inventory, cleaning, temperature, write-off, operational, and other records, checklists, documents, and reports. • Manage and participate in recipe implementation, menu and product development, testing, new-product introduction, and continuous improvement. • Identify operational or employee-performance deficiencies, take appropriate corrective action within assigned authority, and report significant issues to the Manager. • Take all appropriate actions and provide support the Manager in implementing operational decisions, procedures, standards, schedules, and plans and provide accurate information regarding restaurant operations. • Where specifically authorized and assigned in writing by the Employer, assume designated operational and supervisory responsibilities during the Manager’s absence.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.

title: Laboratory Test Engineer
description:
For our client we are looking for a Laboratory Test Engineer to strengthen the project engineering team on automation and protection testing including real time simulations. 

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in power systems, testing and real time simulations. The role focuses on designing and implementing automation, protection and secondary injection tests according to customer specifications. Ideally, the candidate has a vision on how to productize simulation and testing offering. 

You will be mainly accountable for:
· Designing and implementing automation and protection testing including hardware-in-the-loop testing for power systems according to customer specifications
· Leading customer approvals and factory testing of distribution protection relays
· Maintaining the customer approval test laboratory in Vaasa
· Productizing the simulation and test offering

Qualifications For The Role:
· A B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in electrical or electrical power system engineering or equivalent
· Several years of experience working with power systems and prior experience with electrical installations or a commissioning background
· Prior experience of leading customer approvals or FATs (Factory Acceptance Testing)
· Experience with real time simulators such as RTDS, Typhoon Hil or Opal RT and relay test devices and amplifiers such as Omicron
· Experience with PSCAD or a similar software is seen as a strong benefit
· Good communication and presentation skills, including fluency in English (written and spoken), Finnish and Swedish language skills are seen as benefits

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have a B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related field?*
- Do you have at least 3 years of experience working with power systems, electrical installations, or commissioning activities?*
- Have you previously led or participated in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) or customer approval testing for protection or automation systems?*
- Do you have hands-on experience with real-time simulation tools such as RTDS, Typhoon HIL, or OPAL-RT?*
- Do you have experience using relay testing equipment such as Omicron test sets or similar protection testing devices?*
- Do you have experience with PSCAD or similar power system simulation software?*

title: IT Admin / IT Support Specialist, ReOrbit, Helsinki
description:
ReOrbit is looking for a proactive and solutions-driven IT Administrator / IT Support Specialist to support our growing team and help keep our technology running smoothly across all locations.

As our IT Administrator, you will be the go-to person for ensuring a seamless IT experience for employees, both onsite and remotely. Youll play a key role in maintaining reliable systems, supporting modern workplace tools, and enabling the team to work efficiently and securely every day.

It's an exciting chance to join a dynamic start-up, with the opportunity to make a real impact, to reach our goal of pushing the boundaries of space data transfer.

Core responsibilities:

- End-user IT support (Windows, Office 365, Google Workspace)

- Onboarding/offboarding — account creation, device provisioning, access management

- Active Directory / Entra ID and Group Policy administration

- Device management via Intune/MDM

- Hardware support: laptops, printers, mobiles, meeting room AV

- Ticket handling via Atlassian JIRA Service Management

- WiFi and network troubleshooting (LAN/WAN/VPN, connectivity issues)

- Application access management — provisioning, permissions and license assignment across M365, Google Workspace, and Microsoft Dynamics

- Shared mailbox access and licensing administration

- Documentation of processes, user help guides, and basic infrastructure setup notes

Skills and Requirements:

- 3 years in IT administration / end-user support

- Hands-on AD, Intune, and Microsoft 365 administration experience

- Comfortable being a hands-on, on-site presence with minimal supervision

- Fluent English (Finnish a plus, not required)

Application instructions and further information:

This is a six-month temporary agency employment, after which there is an opportunity to become directly employed by ReOrbit.

Register as an applicant and complete the application form carefully, and attach your CV to your application. In your application, please highlight how your strengths support the different aspects and focus areas of the role.

ReOrbit may require a security clearance for certain positions. Any such security clearance will be conducted in accordance with applicable law and the Company's relevant policies.


ReOrbit

What does ReOrbit do?

ReOrbit builds the foundation for the next generation of space applications by transforming satellites into truly intelligent, interconnected platforms, defined by software. Our satellite design philosophy revolves around the idea that satellites must network, communicate with each other and thus improve mission efficiency. How can this be achieved? Thanks to a flexible software-first architecture, where all these aspects are dealt with upfront in the mission concept, as integrated functionalities.

ReOrbits top-notch team of software engineers and system architects develop in-house software, procure hardware from the best-in-class suppliers, and seamlessly integrate the components to create flexible and secure satellites. Today, we are a rapidly growing company building a very strong multidisciplinary team to support our activities. We are headquartered in Helsinki, Finland with a subsidiaries in Bristol, UK, Bariloche, Argentina and Bengaluru, India.

title: IT Lead – Infrastructure, Operations & Support, ReOrbit, Helsinki
description:
ReOrbit is looking for an IT Lead – Infrastructure, Operations & Support to build and scale the infrastructure, operating model and service foundations that enable the company to grow.

As our IT Lead – Infrastructure, Operations & Support, you will take ownership of how ReOrbits core IT infrastructure and operations are designed, managed and scaled. You will combine hands-on technical leadership with strong operational governance, building resilient and repeatable systems across infrastructure, cloud, end-user computing and support.

You will lead the Infrastructure, Operations & Support pillar of ReOrbits multi-year IT strategy, working closely with the Head of IT & Business Systems, Security, Engineering, Manufacturing and external partners. While end-user support will be owned and governed by this role, much of the day-to-day service delivery will be handled through the internal team and an outsourced 24/7 support partner.

It's an exciting chance to join a dynamic start-up, with the opportunity to make a real impact, to reach our goal of pushing the boundaries of space data transfer.

Responsibilities
- Own end-user support and the enterprise 24/7 service model, ensuring the Jira Service Desk operates against defined SLAs and KPIs.
- Lead and manage the outsourced support partner, holding external delivery accountable while retaining ownership of service quality internally.
- Establish and govern core IT operations processes, policies and standards across change, incident, problem and asset management, aligned with ITIL and ITSM principles.
- Define clear ownership models, runbooks and documentation to ensure operational delivery does not depend on individual knowledge.
- Define and govern SLAs, KPIs and operational metrics, producing regular dashboards, reporting and audits that provide clear visibility into service and infrastructure health.
- Manage IT asset inventory, procurement and vendor coordination across the organisation.
- Administer and support core end-user technology platforms, including Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Intune, MDM and Jamf.
- Lead and support the migration from Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace.
- Design, document and maintain ReOrbits IT infrastructure architecture across networks, servers, storage, cloud and end-user computing.
- Develop reference architectures, technical standards and infrastructure designs that can be replicated and expanded as ReOrbit grows.
- Lead the restructuring and scaling of infrastructure to support multi-satellite production, clean-room and OT environments, new facilities and future robotic manufacturing deployments.
- Build scalable and modular infrastructure designs, including network segmentation, VLAN architecture, governed USB access and infrastructure capable of supporting
high-reliability production environments.
- Build and administer core infrastructure across LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN and network security, as well as servers and Microsoft cloud technologies including Active Directory, Entra ID, Azure, SQL and Microsoft Dynamics 365.
- Manage infrastructure capacity, performance, availability and monitoring, identifying risks and bottlenecks before they impact the business.
- Plan and deliver infrastructure projects end-to-end, from scope and design through migration, testing, cutover and documentation.
- Balance speed of delivery with reliability, scalability and controlled technical debt.
- Own the IT infrastructure supporting ReOrbits OT and clean-room environments, including network architecture, connectivity, access control and security.
- Drive automation and continuous improvement across IT operations, including endpoint deployment, onboarding and offboarding, provisioning and monitoring.
- Improve operational workflows by applying Eliminate–Simplify–Standardise–Automate principles.
- Work across systems including Jira, HiBob and Active Directory to automate and streamline employee lifecycle processes.
- Embed security, compliance and resilience into IT operations, including endpoint and cloud controls, access governance, business continuity and disaster recovery.
- Support ISO 27001 readiness and work closely with Security to ensure infrastructure and operational processes meet the required standards.

Skills and Requirements

- 10 years of experience in IT infrastructure, operations and support, including hands-on infrastructure design and delivery in a structured, regulated or high-reliability environment.
- Proven experience designing, documenting and scaling infrastructure across networks, servers, cloud and end-user computing.
- Strong experience developing reference architectures, technical standards and scalable infrastructure designs.
- Strong knowledge of IT operations governance, including ITIL or ITSM principles, change, incident, problem and asset management.
- Experience defining and managing SLAs, KPIs and operational reporting.
- Strong experience with Active Directory, Entra ID, Group Policy, Microsoft cloud infrastructure and Microsoft Intune endpoint management.
- Solid understanding of network and security fundamentals, including LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, network segmentation and endpoint and cloud security controls.
- Experience leading technical teams and managing outsourced or remote support partners against defined SLAs and KPIs.
- Experience administering Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace.
- Hands-on experience with Jira, IT asset management and Confluence.
- Strong documentation, stakeholder communication and vendor management skills.
- Fluent English.
- A hands-on leadership style, with the ability to balance strategic infrastructure design with practical execution.
- Strong ownership, prioritisation and problem-solving skills in a fast-scaling environment.
- A clear bias towards automation, standardisation and building scalable operational systems.

Nice to have

- Experience designing infrastructure for clean-room, OT, high-security or manufacturing environments.
- Experience with segregated, clustered or highly replicable infrastructure designs.
- Experience delivering new site build-outs, data centre or cloud migrations, or disaster recovery implementations.
- Experience leading or supporting a Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace migration.
- Experience optimising Windows infrastructure and applying structured Root Cause Analysis practices.
- PowerShell or other scripting e

title: Project planner
description:
Nordec is a supplier of steel frame structures and façade solutions for construction projects across the Nordic region, with an established presence in Central and Eastern Europe, including Poland, Lithuania, the Czech Republic and Germany.

The company designs, fabricates and installs steel structures for buildings and bridges, covering the project lifecycle from engineering to installation. Projects range from industrial facilities, logistics buildings, data centres, commercial, public, sports and cultural buildings, and bridges. Nordec operates its own production units in Peräseinäjoki and Ylivieska in Finland, Oborniki in Poland and Gargždai in Lithuania.

For more information, visit www.nordec.com.

Our Multi-storey unit continues to grow, and we are now looking to strengthen our team with a

**_PROJECT PLANNER_**

**_Would you like to play a key role in ensuring that complex international projects progress according to plan?_**

As a Project Planner, you will be responsible for preparing, maintaining and monitoring overall project schedules. You will plan project activities and their dependencies, while coordinating schedules across engineering, procurement, production, logistics and installation. You will monitor project progress, anticipate potential delays and scheduling risks, and provide project management and customers with up-to-date information on project status. You will be involved in projects from the tendering phase through to execution, working closely with the Project Manager and the wider project organisation.

To succeed in this role, you have previous experience in project planning and scheduling, along with a good understanding of overall project schedules, activity dependencies, progress monitoring, forecasting and reporting. Experience in EPC/EPCM, industrial, construction, data centre, battery factory or other demanding large-scale projects provides a strong foundation for the role. You can take independent responsibility for project planning and scheduling.

The role requires experience with Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project, as well as a relevant technical degree, for example in civil, construction or mechanical engineering. Strong English skills are essential. You should also be able to communicate in Finnish with your team, while Swedish language skills are considered an advantage. For a candidate with extensive relevant experience, the position may be offered with the title Planning Manager.

An analytical, structured and systematic approach to work is important in this role, along with strong collaboration skills and the ability to take responsibility as part of the wider project organisation.

The preferred location for the position is Seinäjoki or Vaasa, although other Nordec locations are also possible. The role offers flexible remote work. You should also be prepared to travel to factories and project sites, depending on project needs.

At Nordec, you will have the opportunity to work on large international projects in a role where your contribution has a direct impact on their success. You will be supported by an experienced project organisation and have the opportunity to develop both your own expertise and Nordecs project planning and scheduling processes.

The selected candidate will undergo a health examination and drug screening.

For more information about the position, please contact Mikaela Nyberg at WasaTalent, available Mondays to Thursdays, tel. 050 4141 600 or mikaela.nyberg@wasatalent.fi.

Please submit your application directly through WasaTalents recruitment system **no later than 5.10.2026.**

title: (Senior) Data Engineer (Snowflake) – Building and Technical Trade, K Group
description:
Snowflake is becoming the foundation of Building and Technical Trade's future data ecosystem. As a (Senior) Data Engineer, you'll help define how data is modelled, built and utilized across analytics, AI and business development. Rather than joining a fully established environment, you'll have a rare opportunity to influence the development practices, data models and technical standards that will shape our future data platform. We are open to candidates from experienced Data Engineer to Senior Data Engineer level. The exact scope and level of responsibility can be shaped based on your background and expertise.

You will work as part of Kesko's Central Data & Analytics Platforms team while collaborating closely with Building and Technical Trade's Data, AI and ESG team. Together with BI analysts, analytics engineers, data experts and business stakeholders, you'll turn business needs into scalable and reliable data solutions that support both daily decision-making and future growth. We are working in a hybrid workplace model where we combine office days at K Kampus in Kalasatama and remote work to best suit both the role and the team. Come and join our professional team and start building your own kind of career in K Group!

What is the role about?

As a (Senior) Data Engineer, you will be a key data expert helping BTT build a modern Snowflake-based data foundation for analytics, AI and business development. This is a hands-on senior role with strong architectural influence: you will help shape how Snowflake development is done in BTT, while working closely with the BTT Data, AI and ESG team and Keskos central data platform experts. In addition to building solutions, you will help grow the teams Snowflake capabilities through collaboration, mentoring and practical examples.

Your key responsibilities include:
- Technical ownership: owning the technical direction of BTTs Snowflake solutions and ensuring that solutions are reliable, maintainable and aligned with agreed platform principles - Best practices and architecture: defining BTTs Snowflake development practices, including modelling approach, warehouse strategy, documentation, quality and maintainability, while contributing to the broader data architecture and innovation - Mentoring and collaborating: coaching BTT data team members towards stronger Snowflake competence, collaborating with BI analysts, analytics engineers and business stakeholders, and translating business needs into practical data solutions - Building solutions: designing, building and optimizing scalable dbt-based data pipelines, transformations and logical and physical data models



Who are we looking for?

We are looking for an experienced data engineer who enjoys hands-on building but also thinks about the bigger picture, and who genuinely wants to help others grow.

We are not looking for unicorns, but the more of below capabilities are found the better youd fit to the ideal candidate profile:
- Snowflake, dbt and SQL: strong hands-on experience in data engineering with Snowflake, proficiency with dbt for transformations, efficient SQL skills and solid data modelling capability. (This one is actually mandatory) - Modern engineering practices: experience with version control, CI/CD pipelines and a DevOps mindset in a data context; what we develop, we also support. - Background in data warehousing/ETL: You have designed or maintained data pipelines with different technologies. Experience with SAP BW data models and transformations is beneficial, as it helps in understanding our legacy environment. - Data management mindset: Familiarity with data cataloging, lineage tools, semantic views, or overall data governance frameworks. You care about documentation and data quality. - Big picture view: the ability to make sound technical choices across source data, data modelling, transformations and reporting needs, not just build individual pipelines. - Mentoring ability: experience and motivation in sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues and contributing to the development of data engineering practices - AI mindset: interest in leveraging AI to speed up and improve development and maintenance processes - Communication: excellent teamwork and communication skills, and the ability to explain complex data topics to both technical and non-technical colleagues. Fluency in English is required (our working language). Finnish or other Nordic language skills are beneficial but not necessary. - Self-driven and proactive attitude: You take initiative to improve things and arent afraid to suggest new ideas. You are solution-oriented and able to work independently when needed, but also know when to ask for help or input. - Relevant experience with SAP, Aspect4 or web-based business application data as well as familiarity with chain-operated wholesale and/or merchant-led retail business models, especially in the building and technical trade sector










Please note that the role is in Finland and you will need the existing right to work here. Kesko is unable to sponsor work permits or visas.

Why join us?

We offer you the chance to work in a key role, building a modern data platform in a large and diverse organization. Rather than stepping into a fully established environment, you'll have a rare opportunity to help define the development standards, modelling principles and engineering practices that will shape how BTT utilizes Keskos Snowflake platform.

With us you get:
- a genuinely impactful, hands-on role in building our Snowflake data platform from the ground up - a supportive community of expert colleagues in both BTT and Keskos central data teams - the opportunity to influence the technical direction, best practices and ways of working of our future data platform - modern work tools and numerous opportunities to learn, develop and grow your career in a large, international organization - extensive K Group employee benefits, including a mobile-phone benefit, culture, well-being and sports benefit (ePassi Flex), staff discounts in K Group stores, own occupational health care, leisure-time accident insurance, and a car benefit according to our company policy. - partner benefits related to optical stores, accommodation and travel, as well as sports and wellbeing services - a flexible hybrid working model with at least one office day per week

title: AUTOMEKAANIKKO – EKODRIVE OY, KERAVA
description:
**AUTOMEKAANIKKO – EKODRIVE OY, KERAVA**

Ekodrive Oy etsii **itsenäistä ja vastuullista automekaanikkoa** pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Keravalle.

Työvoiman tarve on arviolta **loka–marraskuussa 2026**, mutta etsimme sopivaa henkilöä jo nyt. Jos olet tällä hetkellä töissä mutta harkitset työpaikan vaihtoa myöhemmin syksyllä, voit myös ottaa yhteyttä.

Etsimme mekaanikkoa, joka pystyy hoitamaan tavallisia korjaamotöitä itsenäisesti, tekee työnsä loppuun sovitussa ajassa ja **kantaa vastuun työnsä lopputuloksesta**.

Työhön kuuluu mm.

- määräaikaishuollot ja öljynvaihdot

- jarrujen huolto ja korjaus

- alustan ja ohjauksen korjaukset

- katsastuskorjaukset

- moottori- ja vaihteistoöljyjen vaihdot

- jakohihnojen ja jakopään osien vaihdot

- vikojen etsintä ja perusdiagnostiikka

- rengastyöt

- ilmastointihuollot

- muut tavalliset henkilöautojen korjaamotyöt


Sinun ei tarvitse osata kaikkea, mutta **tavalliset korjaamotyöt pitää pystyä tekemään itsenäisesti**.

Arvostamme mekaanikkoa, joka osaa ajatella käytännöllisesti: vika tutkitaan, korjataan järkevällä tavalla ja työ saatetaan loppuun ilman tarpeetonta asioiden monimutkaistamista.

Odotamme sinulta

- B-luokan ajokorttia

- vastuullisuutta ja luotettavuutta

- oma-aloitteista työotetta

- kykyä tehdä päätöksiä oman työn yhteydessä

- kiinnostusta autoihin ja korjaamiseen

- halua kehittää omaa ammattitaitoa

- kykyä työskennellä normaalisti osana pientä työporukkaa


**Autosähkön, diagnostiikan ja hitsauksen osaaminen on selvä etu.**

Aikaisempi työkokemus autokorjaamolta ja suomen kielen taito ovat plussaa. Työpaikalla voidaan kommunikoida **suomeksi tai venäjäksi**.

Meillä arvostetaan hyvää työilmapiiriä, keskinäistä kunnioitusta ja sitä, että jokainen hoitaa oman työnsä kunnolla.

Meille asiakkaan auto on tärkeä riippumatta sen merkistä, iästä tai arvosta. **Jokainen auto on asiakkaalle tärkeä ja meille työtä.**

Tarjoamme

- vakituisen työn sopivalle henkilölle

- työajan **37,5 h/vko**

- ma–pe **klo 8.00–16.00**

- 6 kuukauden koeajan

- pienen ja kehittyvän työyhteisön

- mahdollisuuden saada enemmän vastuuta ja kehittyä yrityksen kasvaessa

- palkka: **kerro palkkatoiveesi**


Myös **oppilaitoksen kautta tuleva työharjoittelu tai virallinen työkokeilu** voi olla mahdollinen, jos hakijalla on hyvä tekninen perusta, oikea asenne ja realistinen mahdollisuus jatkaa myöhemmin työntekijänä.

HAKEMINEN – VAIN SÄHKÖPOSTITSE

Puhelinhakemuksia emme käsittele.

Pitkää hakemusta ei tarvita. Lähetä lyhyt sähköposti **suomeksi tai venäjäksi** ja vastaa seuraaviin kysymyksiin:

1. Kuinka paljon sinulla on kokemusta automekaanikon työstä?

2. Mitkä korjaukset pystyt tekemään täysin itsenäisesti?

3. Oletko tehnyt jakohihnan/jakopään vaihtoja itsenäisesti?

4. Millainen kokemus sinulla on diagnostiikasta ja autosähköstä?

5. Onko sinulla kokemusta rengastöistä ja ilmastointihuolloista?

6. Onko sinulla voimassa oleva B-ajokortti?

title: Senior Project Manager DSAR Process Transformation
description:
We are looking for a Senior Project Manager for our client in the media sector.

Role Description:
The client is currently looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead the planning and scoping of the automation of our GDPR Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) process. The current process is largely manual and involves multiple teams, systems and data owners. The objective of the assignment is to deliver an approved and actionable plan for future automation, including a documented current-state and gap analysis, aligned Privacy requirements, a governance model and a phased roadmap for technical implementation. The aim is to implement technical automation of the GDPR process starting from next year.

The DSAR process has an established process owner who owns the process and related business decisions. The Senior Project Manager will work closely with the process owner and coordinate the initiative across Privacy, Legal, Data, Technology and relevant business stakeholders. Team size of 15-20 people.

Responsibilities:
· Lead the planning, coordination and overall delivery of the DSAR automation planning project
· Define and maintain project scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones and timelines
· Coordinate the mapping and documentation of the current DSAR process across relevant teams, systems and data sources
· Coordinate the identification of process, compliance, governance and technical gaps together with the process owner and subject-matter experts
· Identify and track open questions, risks, dependencies, blockers and required decisions
· Support the process owner and privacy stakeholders in aligning and documenting privacy requirements and required risk decisions
· Coordinate the definition of the future-state process, governance model, roles and responsibilities
· Coordinate technical stakeholders in identifying automation opportunities, integration needs and technical dependencies
· Ensure agreed business, process and privacy requirements are translated into a clear scope for future technical implementation
· Develop a prioritised and phased roadmap for the technical automation build together with technical stakeholders
· Prepare status reporting, recommendations and decision material for management

Expected Deliverables:
· Current-state process map and scope document
· Gap analysis (process, compliance, governance, technical)
· Documented Privacy requirements and risk decisions
· Governance model with defined roles and responsibilities (e.g. RACI)
· Prioritised, phased automation roadmap
· Approved plan with agreed next steps for implementation

Skills and Qualifications:
· Strong experience leading complex cross-functional transformation, regulatory or technology projects
· Strong project management skills
· Previous experience and knowledge of GDPR, privacy programmes, DSAR/DSR processes or other regulatory processes
· Experience with process or workflow automation
· Experience with enterprise data landscapes involving multiple systems and data owners
· Proven ability to structure ambiguous and fragmented problem areas into clear scope, decisions and deliverables
· Experience coordinating work across business and technical stakeholders
· Experience with current-state assessments, gap analyses and roadmap development
· Strong analytical, documentation and communication skills
· Experience managing project risks, dependencies and competing priorities
· Ability to prepare clear management-level recommendations and decision material

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
1. Have you led a GDPR, privacy, or Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) transformation project from planning through implementation?
2. Have you managed a cross-functional project involving Legal, Privacy, Data, Technology, and Business stakeholders simultaneously?
3. Have you conducted current-state assessments and gap analyses covering process, governance, compliance, and technology areas?
4. Have you planned or delivered workflow/process automation initiatives involving multiple systems and data owners?
5. Have you created and presented governance models, implementation roadmaps, and decision materials to senior leadership or steering committees?

Please apply with your updated CV in English, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role. We offer continuously, which means that we sometimes remove the assignments before deadline. If you are interested, we recommend that you apply immediately.

Location: Finland
Working model: Hybrid working, 1-2 days on a weekly basis in the office, central Helsinki.

Allocation: 60 % allocation.
Language: Fluent written and spoken Finnish (the team is Finnish based). English is seen as a benefit. PLEASE SUBMIT ALL CVS IN ENGLISH.

We offer you: We offer a versatile assignment where every day is different and interesting. We also offer a very competitive salary and good employee benefits.

Are you interested in becoming a part of our dynamic team? The position will be filled as soon as a suitable person is found, so please be quick and submit your application! 

Please include your salary expectation in your application. For more information, contact Kimmo Kärsämä, tel. 050 412 7500, kimmo.karsama@lokki.fi

title: Practice Assistant @ White & Case
description:
Are you a skilled assistant eager to grow your expertise in an international law firm? Do you thrive on helping others in a fast-paced environment? Are you known for your proactive and detail-oriented approach to work?

If you answered **YES**, please keep reading, because this could be the position for you!

**We are looking for** a practice assistant to join White & Case's team in a full-time, permanent position. Key tasks in this role include assisting lawyers with client-related work, along with other tasks to ensure that the daily operations run smoothly at the office. As a practice assistant, you will join a dynamic team of 45 professionals in the Helsinki office.

**In this role,** you will provide assistance across all practice groups. Your responsibilities include a wide range of administrative tasks, such as assisting lawyers with editing and formatting legal documentation, conducting research, providing translation support, as well as preparing and maintaining transaction data rooms. In addition, your duties include liaising with clients, various governmental authorities as well as White & Case's global offices. As a practice assistant, you are also ready to provide support with meeting arrangements, calendar management and other back-office duties.

**You will join** an efficient team of four practice assistants as the fifth member of the team and share your daily work with three evening assistants, a reception assistant and a senior practice assistant. White & Case's team works mainly on-site at their office in the heart of Helsinki, with the flexibility to work remotely once a week during most weeks.

**You may be the person we are looking for if you:**

- have at least one year of experience in a legal assistant or an administrative assistant role within a professional services organization, ideally in a law firm, consulting firm or financial institution;

- have a suitable educational background, such as a Bachelor of Business Administration degree;

- are highly organized and demonstrate great attention to detail;

- enjoy taking initiative and working independently while valuing teamwork and supporting your colleagues;

- are skilled in managing multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a high quality in your work;

- have excellent interpersonal skills and strong written and oral communication skills in Finnish and English; and

- are proficient in MS Office programs (especially Word) and able to quickly learn new software and systems.


**White & Case offers you:**

- an opportunity to work in a dynamic environment within a highly regarded international law firm;

- a diverse, key support role where you will also have the opportunity to assist lawyers with client assignments;

- a close-knit work community that invests in the development of each team member; and

- comprehensive benefits, including extensive occupational healthcare, optional health and accident insurance, and internal training opportunities to support your development. In addition, White & Case offers a selection of alternative benefits, which can be used, for example, for dental care, eyeglasses, a public transport pass, cultural activities or sports.


**Interested?** Send us your CV and cover letter **in English** by **Monday 12 October 2026**. We encourage you to apply early, as we will start reviewing applications already during the application period. If you would like to discuss the position in more detail, feel free to reach out to Minjons recruitment consultant Milla Numminen (from Monday to Wednesday and on Friday, +358 50 336 4396 / milla.numminen@minjon.fi).

_White & Case is a leading global law firm with lawyers and staff in 43 offices across 29 countries, working in virtually every country of the world with a long-established presence in Finland and the Nordic region. White & Case's lawyers and business services professionals are globally minded, enterprising, collaborative and committed to excellence. White & Case operates on a one firm basis, which is present in the day-to-day work of its professionals. They advise multinational corporates, financial institutions and private equity firms on corporate and financing transactions across all major industry sectors. White & Case's core practice areas in Finland are Capital Markets, Debt Finance and M&A/Private Equity._

title: Senior Marketing & Growth Specialist
description:
Vire Advisors kasvaa, ja etsimme uutta osaajaa tiimiin. Keskeinen ajatuksemme **Vaikuttava HR ei ole käsityötä** ohjaa tekemistämme. Sinun tehtäväsi on auttaa tekemään siitä ajatus, jonka markkina tuntee, muistaa ja mielellään myös jakaa eteenpäin.

Autamme yrityksiä modernisoimaan johtamista ja HR-tekemistä teknologian, automaatioiden ja tekoälyn avulla. Samalla rakennamme omia teknologiaratkaisujamme, ja SaaS-alustamme **Arviro©** on nyt siinä vaiheessa, että se tarvitsee työbestiksen, jolla on markkinoinnin seniori-osaamista, vauhtia ja joka osaa vahvistaa SaaS tuotteistamisen kaupallista ajattelua.

Etsimme siis kokenutta **Senior Marketing & Growth Specialistia** vahvistamaan brändiämme, kasvattamaan näkyvyyttämme ja rakentamaan markkinointia, joka näkyy myös liiketoiminnan tuloksissa.

Roolissa yhdistyvät sisältömarkkinointi, sosiaalinen media, tapahtumat, digitaalinen näkyvyys ja kasvun rakentaminen. Etsimme ihmistä, joka osaa rakentaa suunnan mutta ei kavahda käytännön tekemistä.

**Mitä työssäsi teet?**

Vastaat Vire Advisors sisältömarkkinoinnin, sosiaalisen median ja kasvua tukevan markkinoinnin suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta yhdessä asiantuntijoidemme kanssa.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

- sisältökalenterin ja uusien sisältökonseptien rakentaminen

- LinkedIn- ja Instagram-sisältöjen suunnittelu ja toteutus

- blogien, uutiskirjeiden, asiakastarinoiden ja verkkosisältöjen kirjoittaminen

- asiantuntijoiden ajatusten jalostaminen sisällöiksi, joita muutkin kuin asiantuntijat haluavat lukea

- kampanjoiden, webinaarien, messujen ja asiakastilaisuuksien suunnittelu ja toteutus

- verkkosivujen, SEO:n ja AI-haun kehittäminen

- markkinointimateriaalien ja landing pagejen rakentaminen

- analytiikan, liidien ja eri kanavien tulosten seuranta

- markkinoinnin työkalujen ja tekoälyn aktiivinen hyödyntäminen.


Hyvä sisältö ei ole meille itseisarvo. Sen pitää rakentaa tunnettavuuutta, herättää kiinnostusta, vahvistaa asiantuntijabrändiä, synnyttää liidejä ja tukea myyntiä.

**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Etsimme kokenutta B2B-markkinoijaa, jolla on jo näyttöjä siitä, mitä on omalla osaamisellaan saavuttanut.

Toivomme sinulta:

- vahvaa kokemusta B2B-markkinoinnista

- vahvaa sisältömarkkinoinnin ja kirjoittamisen osaamista

- erittäin hyvää LinkedIn- ja Instagram-osaamista

- kokemusta tapahtumista, webinaareista ja kampanjoista

- ymmärrystä SEO:sta, verkkosivuista, analytiikasta ja liidien muodostumisesta

- hyvää visuaalista silmää

- vahvaa markkinoinnin työkalujen tuntemusta

- kykyä hyödyntää tekoälyä tehokkaasti omassa työssäsi

- erinomaista suomen ja englannin kielen osaamista. Aiemmin kokemus kansainvälisiltä markkinoilta on vahva etu.


**Aikaisempi kokemus kasvuyrityksestä sekä SaaS-, teknologia-, asiantuntija- tai ratkaisumyynnin markkinoinnista on meille erittäin tärkeää.** Ja jos tiedät ja osaat selkeästi perustella, että markkinoinnin onnistuminen näkyy muuallakin kuin seuraajamäärässä, saat meiltä monta tykkäystä.

**Millainen henkilö menestyy meillä?**

Menestyt tässä roolissa, jos olet samaan aikaan luova, kaupallinen ja systemaattinen. Tartut asioihin itsenäisesti, viet ideat käytäntöön ja osaat muuttaa suuntaa nopeasti, jos data kertoo, ettei jokin toimi.

Pidät ihmisistä, tapahtumista ja keskusteluista ja saat mielellään asiantuntijasta irti ajatuksen, jota hän ei itse edes tajunnut olevan julkaisemisen arvoinen (big ask, we know ). Uskallat myös haastaa tiiminjäseniä! Huonot ideat nostetaan rohkeasti pöytään ja tehdään niistä yhdessä parempia.

Kasvuyrityksessä kaikki ei ole valmiiksi pureskeltua. Jos tarvitset täydellisen tehtävänannon, kolmen viikon hyväksyntäkierroksen ja kuusi allekirjoitusta ennen julkaisua, emme ehkä ole täydellinen match.

Jos taas nautit siitä, että pääset rakentamaan, kokeilemaan ja näkemään oman kädenjälkesi nopeasti, hae meille!

**Mitä tarjoamme?**

Saat laajan roolin kasvuyrityksessä, jossa markkinointi on yksi kasvun tärkeimmistä moottoreista.

Pääset työskentelemään suoraan omistajien, asiantuntijoiden, myynnin ja teknologiatiimin kanssa sekä vaikuttamaan siihen, miltä Vire Advisors ja Arviro näyttävät ja kuulostavat seuraavassa kasvuvaiheessaan.

Saat vastuuta, vapautta ja tilaa tehdä asioita paremmin kuin me olemme niitä tähän asti tehneet. Itse asiassa sitä me sinulta odotammekin.

**Työpaikka:** Vire Advisors

**Tehtävänimike:** Senior Marketing & Growth Specialist

**Työsuhde:** Vakituinen ja kokoaikainen, se voi myös olla osa-aikainen ja/tai toiminimiyrittäjä. Olemme avoimia monenlaisille työsuhdemuodoille, kunhan osaaminen ja omistautuneisuus ovat kohdallaan.

**Sijainti / hybridityö:** Vire Advisors on tällä hetkellä 100% remote. Ainakin toistaiseksi. Ehdotuksia otetaan vastaan.

**Aloitus:** Mahdollisimman pian, mutta sovittavissa. Meidän monilahjakas markkinoinnin assistentti Sanna päättää määräaikaisuutensa 16.10.2026.

**Hakuaika:** Än, yy, tee, nyt! Hakuaika alkaa nyt, ja päättyy viimeistään 23.10.2026

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Lähetä meille CV ja kerro erityisesti siitä, mistä olet oman osaamisesi suhteen ylpeä, mitä onnistumisia haluat tuoda esiin. Voit mielellään näyttää meille sisältöjä, kampanjoita, tapahtumia tai muita kokonaisuuksia, joista olet ylpeä ja jotka mielestäsi tukevat hakemustasi.

**Meitä kiinnostaa vähemmän se, mistä olet ollut vastuussa. Meitä kiinnostaa enemmän se, mitä sinun ansiostasi tapahtui.**
