title: Capacitaire / Référent du projet animalier (H/F)
description:
Le Parc Animalier de Sainte-Croix entre dans une nouvelle étape de son histoire.
Après 45 ans d'engagement pour le vivant, le parc a souhaité restructurer en profondeur son pôle animalier afin d'en faire un modèle de transmission, de conservation et de bien-être animal, fruit d'une nouvelle d'organisation. Depuis 2 ans nous restructurons le service avec un nouveau cadre managérial de proximité engagé et compétent, des équipes stables et un projet en construction.  

Notre ambition est claire :
Reconnecter toutes les générations au vivant, dans le respect des animaux et des écosystèmes, pour transformer le regard de nos visiteurs sur la nature.
Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons un capacitaire capable d'accompagner cette transformation, non pas uniquement comme garant réglementaire, mais comme référent structurant d'un projet animalier ambitieux.

Le projet :
Le pôle animalier de Sainte-Croix a engagé un travail de restructuration autour de plusieurs priorités :
- Clarifier les rôles et responsabilités de chacun
- Renforcer l'autonomie des responsables de secteur et des équipes
- Structurer les procédures, les circuits de décision et les validations
- Faire monter les équipes en compétence
- Développer une culture forte du bien-être animal
- Mieux intégrer les projets d'élevage, de conservation et de réintroduction ;
- Accompagner l'évolution des infrastructures et des enclos ;
- Donner davantage de sens, de cadre et de fluidité au quotidien animalier.

Ce travail s'inscrit dans la continuité de l'accompagnement mené avec Brice Lefaux, qui a permis de poser un diagnostic, d'identifier les axes de progrès et d'engager une nouvelle dynamique collective.

La mission :
- être le garant du cadre réglementaire, sécuritaire et animalier du parc.
- veiller à ce que les décisions prises soient conformes aux obligations liées à la détention et à la présentation au public d'animaux sauvages, tout en permettant à l'organisation de gagner en maturité et en autonomie.  

Sous la responsabilité directe de la Direction du parc, vous rejoindrez le pôle animalier, une équipe pluridisciplinaire d'une trentaine de collaborateurs composée de vétérinaires, d'un chef de service, de managers de proximité et de soigneurs animaliers. Le poste ne comporte pas de missions de gestion administrative ni d'encadrement d'équipe.
Votre rôle est de poser le cadre, sécuriser les décisions importantes, transmettre votre expertise dans des réflexions collectives et accompagner la montée en compétence et responsabilité des équipes. Et notamment :
- Faire partie du comité de direction avec votre expertise et un bon niveau d'autonomie.

S'engager avec Viveris, c'est l'assurance de relever des défis techniques et humains tout en travaillant sur des projets innovants dans un environnement collaboratif et solidaire.

        Contexte de la mission :

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités technologiques pour un acteur de référence et leader mondial des systèmes d'initiation pour l'industrie minière, nous recherchons un Développeur d'Applications Dart / Flutter Expérimenté (F/H). Intégré(e) au sein de l'équipe R&D et Systèmes Embarqués/Logiciels, vous participez activement à la conception et à l'évolution des outils logiciels et IHM critiques utilisés sur le terrain par les opérateurs et les ingénieurs pour le contrôle et le déclenchement des tirs.

Vos Responsabilités :




- Concevoir, développer et maintenir des applications mobiles et desktop robustes et performantes en utilisant Dart et le framework Flutter ;
- Rédiger un code propre, modulaire, testable et documenté, en respectant les bonnes pratiques de l'architecture logicielle (Clean Architecture, Provider/Bloc) ;
-  Assurer l'interfaçage des applications Flutter avec des équipements matériels spécifiques (systèmes de tir, périphériques de communication sans fil, protocoles industriels) ;
-  Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes produits, les ingénieurs systèmes et les testeurs (QA) pour identifier les besoins et garantir la qualité des livrables ;
- Optimiser les performances des applications sur différentes cibles (Android, iOS, Windows/Linux selon les cas d'usage industriels) ;
-  Participer aux phases de revue de code, de tests unitaires/d'intégration et contribuer à l'amélioration continue des processus de développement (CI/CD).


  
Profil recherché :

De formation supérieure en informatique (Bac+5 / Master / École d'Ingénieurs), vous justifiez d'une expérience significative de 5 ans minimum dans le développement d'applications logicielles, dont une expertise solide et démontrée sur Dart et Flutter.

Environnement technique :


- Maîtrise des concepts avancés de Flutter (gestion d'état, animations, gestion de la mémoire, appels API REST / WebSockets) ;
- Multiplateforme : Expérience avérée dans le développement multiplateforme (Mobile et/ou Desktop) ;
- Compétences connexes : Des connaissances en communication réseau, protocoles industriels ou interfaçage matériel (Bluetooth Low Energy, USB, séries) constituent un réel atout.


Nos avantages :



- Rémunération attractive et évolutive ;
- Mutuelle familiale à garanties hautes ;
- Tickets restaurant pris en charge à 60 % ;
- 100 % du titre de transport urbain remboursé ;
- Primes d'intéressement, de participation et de cooptation ;
- Formation continue avec LinkedIn Learning et nos communautés techniques.

title: Field Application Engineer (FAE) - IA / Semi-conducteurs (H/F)
description:
RESPONSABILITÉS :

Nous recherchons un Ingénieur Applications pour assurer l'interface technique principale entre les clients, les partenaires système et les équipes d'ingénierie Vsora. Ce rôle combine accompagnement client, support technique, intégration de plateformes et résolution de problèmes au niveau système, afin d'assurer le succès du déploiement des solutions IA basées sur l'accélérateur Vsora.


Vos responsabilités :
- Servir de pont entre les clients et les équipes d'ingénierie Vsora, assurant une communication efficace et la priorisation des problèmes techniques. Traduire les exigences clients, les demandes de fonctionnalités et les défis de déploiement en retours actionnables pour les équipes.
- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de validation logicielle, runtime, compilateur, logiciel IA et matériel pour résoudre les problèmes et améliorer le produit.
- Suivre et gérer les escalades clients jusqu'à leur résolution, en maintenant une communication claire avec l'ensemble des parties prenantes.
- Accompagner les fabricants de serveurs, OEM, ODM et partenaires plateforme dans l'intégration des accélérateurs Vsora dans des systèmes de production. Résoudre les problèmes au niveau système impliquant le matériel, le firmware, les drivers, le réseau, le stockage, l'alimentation et la thermique.
- Collaborer avec les équipes hardware pour diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes d'intégration plateforme et d'interopérabilité.

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ :

- Solide expérience en support technique, ingénierie terrain (FAE), solutions engineering, ingénierie client ou intégration système.
- Expérience en infrastructure IA, serving d'inférence, déploiement ML ou plateformes datacenter.
- Familiarité avec les frameworks IA et solutions de serving : PyTorch, ONNX, Hugging Face, vLLM, SGLang, Triton Inference Server ou technologies équivalentes.
- Expérience avec les systèmes Linux, les technologies de containerisation, les systèmes distribués. Compréhension de l'architecture serveur, des accélérateurs PCIe et de l'infrastructure datacenter.
- Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et débogage : hardware, firmware, drivers, systèmes d'exploitation et logiciels applicatifs.
- Excellentes capacités de communication et de relation client, avec la capacité d'interagir efficacement avec des interlocuteurs techniques et non-techniques.
- Expérience avec des OEM, ODM, hyperscalers, cloud providers ou clients enterprise est un fort atout.

title: Réceptionniste H/F - CDD -  Remplacement  (Empfangskraft)
description:
Réceptionniste H/F - CDD - Remplacement

Description du poste

Il s'agit d'un CDD de remplacement, avec une prise de poste prévue le plus vite possible, pour une durée encore indéterminée dans le cadre d'un congé maternité. Celui-ci est prévu jusqu'au mois de janvier minimum, soit une mission d'une durée minimale estimée à 4 mois.

Véritable ambassadeur(rice) de l'établissement, vous êtes le premier point de contact de nos clients et contribuez à leur offrir une expérience chaleureuse et personnalisée tout au long de leur séjour. Vous assurez un accueil professionnel, veillez au bon déroulement des opérations de réception et garantissez un service de qualité conforme aux standards de l'hôtel.

Vos principales missions

- Accueillir les clients avec professionnalisme et convivialité, en français comme en anglais.
- Assurer les procédures de check-in et check-out, ainsi que l'encaissement des prestations.
- Gérer les réservations, les modifications et les annulations via notre système de gestion hôtelière.
- Répondre aux appels téléphoniques, aux e-mails et aux demandes des clients avec réactivité et courtoisie.
- Renseigner les clients sur les services de l'hôtel, les transports, les attractions touristiques et les bonnes adresses locales.
- Traiter les demandes particulières et apporter des solutions adaptées afin de garantir la satisfaction de la clientèle.
- Assurer la coordination avec les différents services de l'hôtel (étages, maintenance, restauration, direction) afin de garantir le bon déroulement des séjours.
- Veiller à la bonne tenue de la réception et des espaces d'accueil, dans le respect des standards de qualité de l'établissement.
- Effectuer les opérations administratives liées à la réception : gestion des encaissements, clôtures de caisse, facturation et suivi des dossiers clients.
- Participer au traitement des réclamations avec professionnalisme et contribuer à la fidélisation de la clientèle.
- Appliquer les procédures internes, les normes de sécurité ainsi que les règles de confidentialité relatives aux informations clients.
- Participer activement à la vie de l'établissement et contribuer à maintenir une ambiance de travail positive et collaborative.

Benefits:

- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!
- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.
- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.
- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.
- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.

Qualifications

- Expérience en réception hôtelière ou dans un poste en contact direct avec la clientèle appréciée.
- Excellente maîtrise du français et bon niveau d'anglais ; toute autre langue constitue un atout.
- Sens développé de l'accueil, du service client et de la satisfaction des clients.
- Excellentes capacités d'organisation, de gestion des priorités et de travail dans un environnement dynamique.
- Aisance avec les outils informatiques, la connaissance d'Opera Cloud ou d'un autre PMS est un plus.
- Capacité à gérer plusieurs tâches simultanément avec rigueur et professionnalisme.
- Excellentes qualités relationnelles, présentation soignée et sens du travail en équipe.
- Autonomie, réactivité et sens des responsabilités.
- Discrétion et respect de la confidentialité.
- Disponibilité pour travailler en horaires variables, y compris les week-ends et jours fériés.

title: Senior Specialist, Product Operations - (Logistics Service) (Business-Analyst/in)
description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Senior Specialist, Product Operations - Logistics Service to join the Product Performance team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

In our Logistics Team, you’ll tackle high-impact challenges that make last-mile delivery efficient, affordable, and sustainable. Your work will directly improve experiences for riders, end customers, and merchants across the globe. Each enhancement you contribute will help Delivery Hero optimize delivery operations, supporting expansion into new areas like grocery and retail.

Our Service Product line is responsible for all customer support-related products, including our in-house agent-facing tools for customer issue resolution, our self-service engine and our global compensation application. Within the Product line, you will be responsible for the performance of our products and work very closely with our product, analytics and data science teams and different entities across the globe to optimize them in order to maximize the value (both cost and top-line) to the business.

- Contribute to improving customer retention and resolving post-delivery issues, with a focus on optimizing self-service experiences
- Run analyses on customer behavior, product usage, and issue resolution patterns to identify opportunities that increase retention, improve experience, and reduce operational costs
- Collaborate closely with product managers, analytics teams, and data scientists to design and evaluate A/B tests and build actionable insights
- Monitor and report on key performance indicators related to retention and post-delivery, ensuring data is accurate, timely, and relevant
- Support regional and local teams by delivering targeted insights, dashboards, and recommendations within your area of specialization
- Identify and communicate areas for product and process enhancements, contributing to prioritization discussions with cross-functional teams
- Contribute to regular reporting and insights for stakeholders and leadership, highlighting both impact and opportunities for efficiency gains

Qualifications

- 4+ years of relevant experience (not counting internships) in a consulting or tech company, working in functions like product operations, user retention, pricing or revenue management
- You have at least a Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative subject - e.g. computer science, physics, mathematics, engineering, social sciences, psychology
- Very strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to draw insights from complex data sets
- You are self-driven and communicative, independent and pragmatic in handling business challenges
- You are proactive, intellectually curious, and motivated by shaping product and business strategy in a high-stakes environment
- Excellent hands on knowledge of reporting tools (Tableau or Looker Studio) & strong hands on knowledge in SQL

Nice to have

- Experience using AI tools in everyday work to bring efficiency and automation
- Experience in a similar large scale tech or e-commerce environment

- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation & Gym.
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers and Food Vouchers.
- Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together10 things you should know about moving to Berlin (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.
- Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/the-5-most-common-interview-questions-and-how-to-answer-them?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) created in collaboration with our recruiters.

Ready to join our team? (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/howwehire) If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

We are currently looking for a Senior Expert Global Compensation & Benefits (m/f/d) for our Headquarters in Stuttgart / Germany.
The Senior Expert Global Compensation & Benefits (m/f/d) is responsible for supporting the Vice President Compensation & Benefits and Mobility in designing, managing, implementing, governing, and continuously improving compensation and benefits programs to align across Exyte's global organization with the Global strategy. The role develops scalable, market-competitive, and compliant solutions that balance global consistency with local market and regulatory requirements. Working globally, this position partners with HR, Finance, Legal, business leaders, and external advisors to strengthen global job architecture, pay structures, incentive programs, benefits governance, and annual reward processes that support attraction, retention, engagement, and internal equity.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

- Global Reward Strategy & Program Design: Partner with the VP Compensation, Benefits & Global Mobility to develop and implement global compensation and benefits strategies, frameworks, and governance models that balance enterprise-wide consistency with local market, legal, and business requirements.
- Global Process Ownership & Execution: Lead and optimize global compensation and benefits processes, including annual salary reviews, bonus planning, pay decisions, budgeting, and benefits harmonization across multiple countries and regions.
- Global Analytics, Benchmarking & Technology: Drive global market benchmarking, reward analytics, pay equity assessments, workforce cost forecasting, and data-driven reporting to support strategic reward and workforce decisions.
- Governance, Compliance & Risk Management: Establish and maintain robust global compensation and benefits policies, governance structures, and compliance frameworks while ensuring adherence to evolving regulatory and reporting requirements.
- Global Stakeholder Advisory & Change Enablement: Serve as a trusted advisor to HR, Finance, Legal, Talent Acquisition, and business leaders, leading global change initiatives, policy transformations, and reward program implementations.
- Vendor & External Partner Management: Own the global vendor strategy for Compensation & Benefits, including provider selection, contract management, service quality oversight, and cost optimization initiatives.
- Global Scope: Operate effectively across international regions, cultures, and time zones, fostering collaboration within a global environment and supporting business needs through occasional international travel.
- Program & Project Leadership: Lead complex global reward projects, including M&A integrations, job architecture initiatives, compensation technology implementations, pay transparency programs, benefits harmonization, and organizational change activities.

Show your expertise

- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
- Multiple years of professional experience, including significant experience in global or multi-country compensation and benefits roles
- Deep expertise in global compensation and benefits strategy, job architecture, market benchmarking, salary structures, incentive design, and annual reward processes.
- Strong knowledge of global governance and the ability to translate enterprise principles into practical, locally compliant solutions.
- Experience working across multiple countries and regions within a complex, matrixed multinational organization.
- Advanced analytical, financial-modeling, and data-visualization capability, including expert-level Excel skills and experience with HRIS and reporting tools.

- Strong project, change, and vendor-management skills, with the ability to manage concurrent global initiatives.
- Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and cross-cultural communication skills; professional fluency in English.

What we offer you

title: Junior Controller Product Costing & Inventory Valuation (m/f/d) - Hybrid Option GER (Buchhalter/in)
description:
WELCOME TO BASF

In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As a specialized service unit we ensure a high level of customer orientation and we design our services to be cooperative, efficient and future-oriented.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT
Are you interested in accounting, controlling, manufacturing processes and understanding how product costs are built up? Then join our Product Costing & Inventory Valuation team. In this role, you develop expertise in Cost Accounting, Inventory Valuation and SAP S/4HANA processes while working closely with finance, controlling and operational teams worldwide.

- You support month-end and year-end closing activities, including Product Costing, Inventory Valuation and financial reporting processes.
- You analyze, validate and monitor standard and actual product costs in SAP, including the execution of product costing runs.
- Besides that, you investigate cost deviations, perform root cause analyses and collaborate with manufacturing, accounting and controlling teams to ensure accurate product cost calculations.
- In this role, you review, maintain and validate costing-relevant master data to ensure high data quality and accurate inventory valuation.
- Last but not least, you provide operational support for SAP S/4HANA Product Costing processes and contribute to process improvements, harmonization initiatives and automation projects.
- bachelor's or master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics or a related field
- first experience in accounting, cost accounting, inventory accounting, manufacturing finance or controlling, gained through internships, working student positions or initial professional roles
- good understanding of accounting principles, financial closing processes, cost accounting and inventory valuation, with a strong interest in manufacturing environments
- experience with SAP ERP, SAP CO, Product Costing, Material Ledger or SAP S/4HANA is an advantage
- structured and analytical way of working, strong attention to detail, and fluent English communication skills, additional European languages are a plus

WHAT WE OFFER

- Gross annual salary (full-time): 40.000 - 46.000 €, depending on qualifications and professional experience - In addition, you can expect a bonus dependent on the company's success

title: Plant Manager - Marl (Werkleiter/in)
description:
Der Plant Manager ist für die Gesamtleitung von zwei Produktionsstandorten in Marl verantwortlich. Der Schwerpunkt der Position liegt auf Arbeitssicherheit, Produktion, operativer Effizienz sowie der Koordination der Logistik.

Die Position umfasst die Steuerung des täglichen Betriebs und stellt gleichzeitig die Einhaltung der EHS-Vorschriften, Qualitätsstandards, gesetzlichen Anforderungen und Unternehmensrichtlinien sicher. Der Site Manager führt das Standortteam und treibt die kontinuierliche Verbesserung in den Bereichen Produktion, Qualität, Kosten und operative Leistungsfähigkeit voran.

Verantwortlichkeiten:

- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung aller geltenden EHS-Gesetze und -Vorschriften sowie der internen Group-Richtlinien an den Produktionsstandorten.
- Verantwortung für Produktionsleistung, Produktqualität, Durchsatz und termingerechte Lieferungen.
- Planung und Überwachung der operativen Budgets sowie Sicherstellung einer effektiven Kostenkontrolle.
- Kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Produktionsprozesse unter Anwendung von Lean-Manufacturing-Prinzipien.
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung aller lokalen und unternehmensinternen EHS-Anforderungen, einschließlich Gefährdungsbeurteilungen und arbeitsmedizinischer bzw. arbeitshygienischer Programme.
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher Anforderungen hinsichtlich des sicheren Betriebs und der Instandhaltung von Produktionsanlagen und Maschinen.
- Abstimmung der Produktionskapazitäten und Personalplanung mit den Anforderungen der Logistik.
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Anforderungen und Ziele gemäß ISO 9001, ISO 14001 und ISO 50001.
- Verbesserung von Qualität, Ausbeute, Durchsatz, Anlagenverfügbarkeit und Kosten durch kontinuierliche Verbesserungsmaßnahmen und OPEX-Projekte.
- Identifizierung von Investitionsmöglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Anlageneffizienz und Ausbeute.
- Sicherstellung, dass die Produktionskosten innerhalb der genehmigten Budgets bleiben.
- Erstellung regelmäßiger Betriebs- und Leistungsberichte für den zuständigen Vorgesetzten, einschließlich: - Operative Leistungskennzahlen
- Qualität der Fertigprodukte in Zusammenarbeit mit der Qualitätsabteilung
- Wesentliche Produktions- und Kostenkennzahlen
- Sicherstellung einer effektiven Instandhaltung zur Minimierung von Stillstandszeiten und Maximierung der Anlagenverfügbarkeit.
- Führung, Entwicklung, Coaching und Motivation des Standortteams.
- Bearbeitung von Leistungs- und Verhaltensangelegenheiten bei Bedarf.
- Organisation und Überwachung der vierteljährlichen und jährlichen Bestandsaufnahmen.
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Abteilungen Logistik, Qualität, Instandhaltung, EHS, Finanzen und HR.
- Nationale und internationale Reisetätigkeit nach Bedarf (ca. 5 %).

Anforderungen:

- Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Ingenieurwesen, z. B. Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Maschinenbau, Verfahrenstechnik, Bergbau oder einer verwandten Fachrichtung bzw. eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
- Fundierte praktische Erfahrung in einem produzierenden, industriellen, bergbaulichen oder vergleichbaren Produktionsumfeld.
- Gute Kenntnisse im Bereich der Betriebs- und Produktionsabläufe, einschließlich Arbeitssicherheit, Produktion, Qualität, Prozesse, Instandhaltung und Investitionsprojekte (CapEx).
- Erfahrung in der Führung von Teams sowie im operativen Management.
- Ausgeprägte Führungs-, Entscheidungs- und Problemlösungskompetenz.
- Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten in einem dynamischen und schnelllebigen Umfeld zu steuern.
- Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit.
- Ausgeprägter Fokus auf Sicherheit, Qualität, operative Exzellenz und Kundenanforderungen.
- Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

As a global organisation operating across multiple countries, compensation for this role may vary depending on location, local market benchmarks, and experience.
In line with our commitment to pay transparency, a salary range relevant to your location will be shared with you during the early stages of the recruitment process, before any interview is scheduled.

title: Hero Support Specialist (Assistent/in - Personalwesen)
description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Specialist, Hero Support to join the People & Culture team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

- Your Role: As a Specialist in Hero Support, you will play a key role in managing HR operations, optimizing employee lifecycle workflows, and ensuring smooth service delivery across DHSE Central. You'll bring a blend of strong operational expertise and a continuous improvement mindset to keep our processes efficient, compliant, and candidate- and employee-friendly.
- Operations & Case Management: Act as a primary operational contact for employee and manager queries via Jira, Slack, and email, independently resolving mixed-complexity tickets per month while maintaining >90% SLA adherence.
- End-to-End Lifecycle Operations: Execute employee lifecycle processes including employment contracts, amendments, probation management, transfers, and terminations, supporting a wide range of teams across the organization.
- Data Integrity & Compensation Administration: Maintain accurate employee records in Workday and support pre-payroll data reconciliation, one-time payments, and compensation updates with 95% accuracy and strong attention to compliance.
- Stakeholder Collaboration & Advisory: Apply working knowledge of German labor law and company policies to partner effectively with Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Legal, and People Partners, serving as a trusted consultative advisor to managers and stakeholders across the business.
- Process Improvement & Automation: Identify operational bottlenecks and drive workflow enhancements in Workday and Jira, implementing process improvements per quarter to continuously elevate the employee experience.
- Knowledge Management: Maintain clear documentation, SOPs, and self-service Knowledge Base resources for employees and managers.
- Projects & Operational Excellence: Support cross-functional initiatives across HR compliance, process digitization, and audit readiness to enhance scalability and service quality.

Qualifications

- 1–3+ years of hands-on experience in HR Operations or People Operations, managing end-to-end employee lifecycle processes in a fast-paced environment.
- Solid understanding of German labor law, social security regulations, and general HR administrative compliance.
- Strong proficiency with modern HR systems, particularly Workday and ticketing platforms like Jira or ServiceNow.
- A customer-centric, empathetic mindset with a strong focus on high-quality service delivery.
- Strong detail orientation, problem-solving skills, and ability to prioritize in a dynamic workflow.
- Excellent communication skills in English (C1+) and strong working knowledge of German (B1+ minimum).
- Experience in global mobility operations and business travel administration is considered a strong plus.

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation, Gym & Bicycle Subsidy
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers, Food Vouchers, Corporate Discounts. Courses.
- Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.

Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/the-5-most-common-interview-questions-and-how-to-answer-them?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) created in collaboration with our recruiters.

delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

title: Technical Documentation Writer - Defense Technology - Permanent (H/F)
description:
Salary: 65-80k€ (Annuel)

TECHNICAL DOCUMENTATION WRITER - DEFENSE TECHNOLOGY (F/M)

Contract type Permanent position (Full-time)

Location Erding / Greater Munich Area, Germany (Hybrid)

Reference 2387

Contact

COMPANY PRESENTATION

Our client is an innovative defense technology company developing next-generation solutions that combine advanced sensors, secure communications, and intelligent data processing. Their systems support military and law enforcement operators by providing reliable situational awareness in demanding operational environments.

KEY POINTS OF THE POSITION

* Own the complete technical documentation landscape across multiple projects
* Work closely with engineering, quality, and production teams
* Play a key role in a highly regulated and mission-critical environment
* Drive documentation quality, consistency, and compliance from development through delivery

RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Technical Writer, your responsibilities will include:

* Create and maintain technical datasheets for products, subsystems, and components
* Write user manuals, installation guides, maintenance procedures, and technical documentation
* Ensure documentation remains accurate, structured, version-controlled, and aligned with product evolution
* Gather, review, and organize supplier certificates, test reports, and quality documentation
* Prepare complete documentation packages for customer deliveries, audits, and compliance requirements
* Develop training materials and documentation for internal teams and customers
* Collaborate with engineers to collect, understand, and validate technical information
* Identify documentation gaps, inconsistencies, and risks before they impact projects
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of documentation processes and standards

NECESSARY SKILLS

* Proven experience as a Technical Writer in an industrial or engineering environment
* Strong ability to translate complex technical information into clear and structured documentation
* Experience working with technical specifications, engineering drawings, test reports, and product data
* Familiarity with documentation management, version control, and review processes
* Knowledge of quality standards and regulated environments (ISO 9001 or similar) is highly desirable
* Experience with Jira, Git, or similar documentation/version control tools is a plus
* Background in defense, aerospace, railway, medical devices, electronics, or other critical industries is advantageous
* Flawless German is mandatory
* Professional fluency in English
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently
* Eligibility for German security clearance (SÜ2/Ü2) is required

SALARY

€65,000 - €80,000 gross annual salary, depending on experience, technical expertise, and overall fit.

  • nadzor nad NDT ispitivanjima: koordinacija i nadzor nad ispitivanjima bez razaranja (NDT - ultrazvuk, radiografija, penetranti, magnetofluks).
  • upravljanje dokumentacijom: izrada i kontrola popratne QA/QC dokumentacije, testnih izvještaja (ITP - Inspection and Test Plans), atesta materijala i završnih knjiga kvalitete.
  • rješavanje nesukladnosti (NCR): identificiranje odstupanja od projekta ili normi, otvaranje izvještaja o nesukladnosti (NCR), te predlaganje i nadzor korektivnih mjera.
  • suradnja i koordinacija: komunikacija s klijentima, nadzornim inženjerima, proizvodnjom i vanjskim institucijama (inspekcijskim tijelima). Poslodavac na terenu osigurava smještaj i prijevoz. Radnici se u inozemstvu zapošljavaju kao izaslani radnici.

Wir erwarten
* Echtes Engagement für unsere Mandanten durch gelebte Praxis: "Mache jede Steuererklärung so, als wäre es deine eigene" ist bei uns keine hohle Phrase, sondern gelebte Praxis

* Unternehmerisch denkende, kommunikative Persönlichkeiten, die ihren festen Mandantenkreis umfassend betreuen wollen
* Kurz gesagt: Wir suchen "Allrounder", die ihr Fachwissen und Können pragmatisch anwenden wollen und Lust auf Karriere haben
* Umsatz und Effizienz ist für uns nicht alles. Wir sind ein Team, daher sollten Sie sich auch bei der Ausbildung der Azubis oder für organisatorische Fragestellungen engagieren wollen

Wir suchen
* Steuerleute mit Qualifikation. Wie alt Sie sind, ist für uns unerheblich. Wir geben Berufseinsteigern genauso eine Chance wie "alten Hasen".
* in Voll- oder Teilzeit (mindestens drei halbe Tage). Die Möglichkeit zu Homeoffice besteht grundsätzlich, allerdings schätzen wir das tägliche Miteinander in der Kanzlei mehr und wollen Sie so bestmöglich in unser Team integrieren
* Auch Quer- oder Wiedereinsteiger sind bei uns willkommen! Wir legen großen Wert auf Aus- und Weiterbildung, daher unterstützen wir Sie gerne beim (Wieder-) Einstieg
* Mitarbeiter mit Engagement, fachlichen Ehrgeiz und Mandantenorientierung
* Mitarbeiter, die in einer inhabergeführten, kleinen Kanzlei kurze Entscheidungswege und offene Türen schätzen, die sich gegenseitig unterstützen und die gerne im Team arbeiten und denken
* Kollegen/-innen mit Berufserfahrung, sicheren Umgang mit Microsoft Office und Datev (z.B. Unternehmen Online, elektronisches Bankbuchen, ...)
* Eigenverantwortung, Qualitätsbewusstsein, Zuverlässigkeit, ausgeprägte Dienstleistungsorientierung und Freude am Umgang mit Menschen, Kollegialität und Teamfähigkeit runden Ihr Profil ab

title: Juriste transfrontalier franco-allemand (H/F)
description:
Vos missions :
- Traitement de demandes d'informations et de réclamations de consommateurs et sur cette base identification de problématiques récurrentes en matière de consommation transfrontalière.
- Contribution active à la défense des intérêts collectifs des consommateurs à l'échelle transfrontalière, notamment par l'élaboration d'études, de notes et d'analyses juridiques.
- Suivi actif des évolutions juridiques, politiques et sociétales dans la région frontalière franco-allemande.
- Participation au développement de projets et de mesures visant à renforcer la protection des consommateurs dans la région frontalière, en coopération étroite avec la Direction générale.
- Rédaction et mise à jour d'informations destinées aux consommateurs pour les supports numériques et autres formats de communication.
- Participation active à des réunions, conférences, groupes de travail à dimension juridique, politique et/ou administrative, dans le secteur de la coopération franco-allemande.
- Collaboration avec des organisations partenaires allemandes et françaises ainsi qu'avec des services spécialisés internes et externes.

title: Erzieher für stationäre Wohngruppe (m/w/d) (Erzieher/in)
description:
Erzieher für stationäre Wohngruppe (m/w/d)

Arbeitsort: Berlin und Brandenburg

Für unsere stationären Wohngruppen in Berlin und Brandenburg suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt:

Pädagogische Superhelden:innen und Altagsgestalter:innen mit Herz (all genders) in VZ, TZ, Minijobber

Wir bieten dir:

- Eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit in einem herzlichen und abwechslungsreichen Umfeld
- Flexible Einsatzorte, Erfahrung und viele neue Eindrücke sowie die Möglichkeiten, dein Können in unterschiedlichen Kontexten einzubringen
- Gehalt je nach Berufserfahrung in Anlehnung an den TVL-S (ab 3489,55€ bei VZ)
- 30 Tage Urlaub, DUZ, VBLU, Sabbatical, Jahressonderzahlung
- Supervision und Fachteams sowie interne und externe Fort- und Weiterbildungsangebote

Was dich erwartet:

- Flexible Einsatzmöglichkeiten nach Absprache
- Unterschiedliche Einsatzbereiche mit abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben in Berlin und Brandenburg
- Ein herzliches und unterstützendes Team

Dein Profil:

- Du kannst spontan einspringen, bleibst auch dann ruhig, wenn der Tagesplan sich fünfmal ändert, und findest schnell deinen Platz
- Du begleitest u.a. auch gern Ferienfreizeiten und behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn Zahnbürsten verschwinden und Schlafenszeiten verhandelt werden
- Du verfügst über eine pädagogische Grundausbildung (Erzieher:in, Pädagog:in, Heilpädagog:in, Sozialpädagog:in, etc.) und vorzugsweise erste Erfahrung im Berufsalltag

title: Pädagogische/r Mitarbeiter/in (m/w/d) im Betreuten Wohnen für junge Flüchtlinge (Sozialarbeiter/in / Sozialpädagoge/-pädagogin)
description:
INSBI gGmbH / Institut für soziale und berufliche Integration gGmbH

Wir suchen:
Sozialarbeiter/in, Sozialpädagoge/in, Diplom/BA-Pädagoge/in, Erzieher/in (m/w/d)

Zu uns:
Die INSBI bietet betreutes Wohnen für unbegleitete minderjährige Flüchtlinge (UmF) ab 16 Jahren und für junge Volljährige an. Unser Ziel ist es, diesen Menschen einen sicheren und stabilen Lebensraum zu bieten, in dem sie Vertrauen, Orientierung und Perspektiven für ihre Zukunft entwickeln können.

In Zusammenarbeit mit Jugendämtern und Bildungsträgern setzen wir uns für die gesellschaftliche und berufliche Integration junger Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen ein. Unsere Arbeit basiert auf einem ressourcenorientierten Ansatz und folgt dem Prinzip des Empowerments: Wir begleiten die Jugendlichen individuell und stärken sie in ihrer persönlichen und beruflichen Entwicklung.

Besonders für junge Flüchtlinge, die oft traumatische Erlebnisse hinter sich haben, ist eine stabile und vertrauensvolle Beziehung essenziell. Durch unser Bezugsbetreuersystem bieten wir Halt, Orientierung und fördern ihre Selbstständigkeit.

Mit unserer langjährigen Erfahrung in der Jugendhilfe und Flüchtlingshilfe gestalten wir ein Umfeld, das Sicherheit, Schutz und eine realistische Zukunftsperspektive ermöglicht. Dabei legen wir Wert auf interkulturelle Sensibilität, Reflexion und eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Akteuren, um den Jugendlichen bestmögliche Chancen zu bieten.

Darum geht's - Ihre Aufgaben
Als pädagogische/r Mitarbeiter/in in der ambulanten Betreuung im Betreuten Wohnen für minderjährige und junge volljährige Flüchtlinge übernehmen Sie unter anderem folgende Aufgaben:

- Anleitung und Unterstützung der jungen Menschen im lebenspraktischen Bereich, im Besonderen der Verselbstständigung in einer eigenen Wohnung oder WG.
- Begleitung und Unterstützung bei der Abklärung asyl- und aufenthaltsrechtlicher Fragen und der Sicherstellung des Lebensunterhalts
- Einzelförderung im schulischen, beruflichen, sozial-emotionalen und gesundheitlichen Bereich sowie Freizeitgestaltung
- Krisenintervention
- Zusammenarbeit mit Jugendämtern, Behörden, Rechtsanwältinnen, Schulen, Ausbilderinnen und Ärzt*innen
- Verwaltungstätigkeiten wie Dokumentation und Aktenführung
- Teilnahme an Teamsitzungen, Teamsupervision und Weiterbildungen.

Das bringen Sie mit - Ihr Profil

- Sie verfügen über eine Ausbildung/ein Studium zum/zur Sozialpädagoge/in oder Sozialarbeiter/in, Diplom/BA Pädagoge/in oder Erzieher/in oder sind Werksstudent/in und haben Freude an der Begleitung junger Menschen.
- Erfahrung in der pädagogischen Arbeit.
- Fähigkeit zur professionellen Beziehungsarbeit und die Bereitschaft zur kultursensiblen Arbeit.
- Kreativität, Flexibilität und Kooperationsfähigkeit.
- Freude an eigenständiger Arbeitsweise.

Unser Angebot - Ihre Vorteile

- Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit einer attraktiven Vergütung, die sich an der Berufsausbildung und der beruflichen Vorerfahrung orientiert.

- Einkaufen und Erledigung von Besorgungen
- Zubereitung von Mahlzeiten und gemeinsames Kochen
- Unterstützung bei der Wäschepflege

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: Csoportkoordinátor- Külső csomagolási projektek (Leiter/in - Logistik)
description:
Bevezetés

Részt venni a változás alakításában. Egy lépéssel megelőzni a holnap kihívásait már ma. Együtt növekedni egy fejlődő iparágban. Értékeink mentén, felelősen viselkedni. TÚLLÉPNI A HATÁROKAT. Ezt jelenti a DEUFOL csapatában dolgozni.
Világszerte 3 kontinensen, 12 ország 90 telephelyén, 2400 motivált munkatársunkkal, globális szereplők vagyunk az ellátási lánc megoldások és az ipari csomagolás területén.

Milyen feladatokra számíthatsz?

- Külső (a Deufol Hungary telephelyén kívül megvalósítandó) csomagolási és logisztikai projektek megvalósításának menedzsmentje az üzleti partnereink telephelyein (Debrecenen belül, illetve kívül, több változó helyszínen a régióban), a munkavállalók és a szakmai feladatok koordinálása
- A különféle külső helyszíneken az ipari termékek szakszerű, a megrendelésben meghatározott specifikációknak megfelelő csomagolásának, valamint a lecsomagolt termékek adminisztrációs, anyagmozgatási feladatainak biztosítása, a tevékenységek koordinálása
- Az ügyfélelégedettség biztosítása a külső csomagolási projektek során: egyeztetés a helyi kapcsolattartóval a helyszínen elvégzendő feladatokról, prioritásokról, reklamációs esetek kivizsgálása és részvétel a reakciós folyamatban.
- A külső csomagolási tevékenységekhez felhasznált csomagolóanyagok helyszínre történő kiszállítása céges autóval, szükség esetén fuvarszervezés
- A csapat tevékenységéhez kapcsolódó dokumentációs, riportolási és adminisztrációs feladatok ellátása a csoportvezető felé
- Együttműködés a cégen belüli társterületekkel, illetve a külső partnerekkel

Hozzád illik a pozíció, ha:

- Magabiztos, releváns tapasztalattal rendelkezel kisebb, néhány fős csapat vezetésében és koordinálásában gyártási, termelési, raktári, logisztikai területen
- Magabiztos számítógép-felhasználói ismeretekkel rendelkezel, gyakorlottan használod a MS Office alkalmazásokat; előny, ha valamilyen logisztikai, vállalatirányítási szoftver használatában van már tapasztalatod
- Legalább középfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel; előny a szakirányú végzettség vagy tapasztalat logisztika, ellátási lánc menedzsment, ipari csomagolási, faipari, raktári területen
- Vállalod a külső helyszíneken történő munkavégzést, a rendszeres kiküldetéseket Magyarországon belül, illetve szükség esetén (várhatóan nagyon ritka esetben) külföldre is - a munkavégzésed helyszíne részben a Deufol Hungary székhelye, részben a különböző partnereink telephelyei lesznek
- Rendelkezel B kategóriás jogosítvánnyal és vezetési tapasztalattal
- Előnyt jelent, ha rendelkezel érvényes targoncavezetői vagy híddaru kezelői jogosítvánnyal
- Terhelhető, rugalmas vagy
- Önálló, felelősségteljes munkavégzés jellemez
- Jó kommunikációs, szervező- és problémamegoldó készséggel rendelkezel
- Pozitív, csapatjátékos és ügyfélközpontú hozzáállásod van
- Alapfokú aktív angol nyelvtudás előny (mindennapi munkahelyi helyzetekben tudod használni, pl. e-mailezés, egyszerű telefonhívások/helyszíni egyeztetések)

Hogyan tudunk inspirálni?

- Stabil cég vagyunk, hosszú távon számíthatsz ránk és mi is hosszú távon gondolkodunk benned
- 180 fős munkavállalói létszámunk biztosítja a közvetlen, támogató közeget, ahol a vezetők is mindig elérhetők
- Innovatív, növekvő nemzetközi vállalati környezetben dolgozhatsz
- Érdekes és felelősségteljes feladatokat végezhetsz, csapatban közösen és a saját tudásod, kreativitásod és személyiséged használva
- Piacnak megfelelő juttatási csomagga

title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Senior QA Analyst
description:
As a Senior Quality Assurance Analyst on an EVE Online gameplay team, you will guide testing from early design through release and live monitoring. You will work closely with design, engineering, and production to identify risks, shape test coverage, and help the team deliver reliable, engaging gameplay.

You will develop deep knowledge of your team's gameplay systems and how they interact with the wider game. As an advocate for players, you will contribute to design discussions, challenge assumptions, and provide actionable feedback on gameplay and usability. You will also coordinate outsourced testing while improving how the team builds quality into everyday development.

Your Tasks
Own the team's test approach, maintaining test plans, cases, regression coverage, and supporting documentation with input from the team.
Perform hands-on testing of gameplay features, mechanics, and interactions with existing systems, from design through release.
Assess quality risks, estimate testing effort, and partner with the producer to ensure adequate testing time and coverage. Coordinate testing across the development team and outsourced testers, providing clear priorities, instructions, and feedback.
Drive collaboration across teams and encourage shared ownership of quality.
Manage defects through triage, investigation, prioritization, and verification, helping the team make informed release decisions.
Review player bug reports, external issue lists, and relevant forum discussions to identify issues within the team's domain.
Coordinate deployment testing and post-release verification, communicating results and outstanding risks.
Ensure coverage across PC and Mac, including appropriate platform, performance, and regression testing.
Monitor relevant code, asset, and data changes, and coordinate access to working test environments, tools, and pipelines.
Improve testing practices and identify opportunities for automation, contributing to automated tests where appropriate.

Your Profile
At least five years of software or game testing experience, including coordinating and working effectively with outsourced testers.
A thorough understanding of development processes and testing throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate game mechanics, controls, interfaces, player feedback, rules, and rewards.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to reproduce, isolate, and clearly document defects.
The ability to prioritize testing based on risk and communicate quality concerns clearly.
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong collaboration skills.
An organized, methodical, and proactive approach, combined with curiosity and creative problem-solving.

Nice to Have:
Familiarity with Scripting, Python or other programming languages.
Experience with test automation.
Experience working in Agile development teams.
Knowledge of EVE Online or experience testing complex multiplayer gameplay systems.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Senior QA Analyst
description:
As a Senior Quality Assurance Analyst on an EVE Online gameplay team, you will guide testing from early design through release and live monitoring. You will work closely with design, engineering, and production to identify risks, shape test coverage, and help the team deliver reliable, engaging gameplay.

You will develop deep knowledge of your team's gameplay systems and how they interact with the wider game. As an advocate for players, you will contribute to design discussions, challenge assumptions, and provide actionable feedback on gameplay and usability. You will also coordinate outsourced testing while improving how the team builds quality into everyday development.

Your Tasks
Own the team's test approach, maintaining test plans, cases, regression coverage, and supporting documentation with input from the team.
Perform hands-on testing of gameplay features, mechanics, and interactions with existing systems, from design through release.
Assess quality risks, estimate testing effort, and partner with the producer to ensure adequate testing time and coverage. Coordinate testing across the development team and outsourced testers, providing clear priorities, instructions, and feedback.
Drive collaboration across teams and encourage shared ownership of quality.
Manage defects through triage, investigation, prioritization, and verification, helping the team make informed release decisions.
Review player bug reports, external issue lists, and relevant forum discussions to identify issues within the team's domain.
Coordinate deployment testing and post-release verification, communicating results and outstanding risks.
Ensure coverage across PC and Mac, including appropriate platform, performance, and regression testing.
Monitor relevant code, asset, and data changes, and coordinate access to working test environments, tools, and pipelines.
Improve testing practices and identify opportunities for automation, contributing to automated tests where appropriate.

Your Profile
At least five years of software or game testing experience, including coordinating and working effectively with outsourced testers.
A thorough understanding of development processes and testing throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate game mechanics, controls, interfaces, player feedback, rules, and rewards.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to reproduce, isolate, and clearly document defects.
The ability to prioritize testing based on risk and communicate quality concerns clearly.
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong collaboration skills.
An organized, methodical, and proactive approach, combined with curiosity and creative problem-solving.

Nice to Have:
Familiarity with Scripting, Python or other programming languages.
Experience with test automation.
Experience working in Agile development teams.
Knowledge of EVE Online or experience testing complex multiplayer gameplay systems.

The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers.

title: Chef Manager
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Chef Manager Location: Ringaskiddy, Co. Cork Salary: €50,000 per annum Contract: Permanent, Full Time About the Role We are looking for an experienced and passionate Chef Manager to lead our catering operation at Pfizer Ringaskiddy. This is a hands-on leadership role for a chef who takes pride in delivering high-quality food, exceptional service and consistently high standards. You will lead and support the kitchen team, oversee the full food cycle from delivery through to service, and ensure that catering services are delivered safely, efficiently and to the required client standards. You will also play a key role in supporting the day-to-day operation of the unit and deputising for the Business Manager when required. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage the kitchen team to deliver excellent food and service. Plan weekly menus and ensure all food and supply requirements are ordered on time. Maintain the highest standards of food quality, hygiene, preparation, presentation and service. Ensure allergen and HACCP documentation is completed accurately and on time. Manage food costs, labour costs and expenditure within agreed budgets. Ensure stock is correctly stored, organised and rotated. Drive the daily use of the Leanpath Waste Management System and actively reduce food waste. Ensure all food preparation and production complies with company standards and procedures. Maintain compliance with Health & Safety, hygiene, fire, COSHH and site requirements. Monitor equipment to ensure it is safe, maintained and fit for use. Support continuous improvement and identify opportunities to enhance the catering service. Build and maintain excellent relationships with clients and customers. Respond professionally to customer feedback, compliments and complaints. Support recruitment, induction, training, development and performance management of the kitchen team. Lead regular team briefings and ensure staff maintain a positive, friendly and professional approach. Support the achievement of service level agreements, KPIs, audit standards and client satisfaction targets. What We're Looking For We're looking for a confident and commercially aware Head Chef with proven experience leading a kitchen team. You will ideally have: Proven experience managing and leading a kitchen team. Strong knowledge of the catering industry and awareness of current developments and innovations. Excellent budgeting and financial management skills. Experience working within a standards-driven or compliance-focused environment. A strong customer-service mindset. Excellent communication and negotiation skills. Creativity, personal innovation and a genuine passion for food. Experience implementing and driving company initiatives. Relevant culinary qualifications and training. Sodexo reserves the right to close this advert early if we are in receipt of a high number of applications.

In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
You will be a healthcare assistant working across our Social Care division. Hours: Full time permanent 40 hours Salary ranges from €33,530 to €36,004, however this may be increased based on Qualifications and Experience What is the Role? You will provide a professional, high quality and safe service as a healthcare assistant to people with additional needs - working as part of a team and in consultation with each service user. You will make sure all of the client's needs are met in a completely individual way, and as an ambassador of Resilience's values, you will represent Best Quality - providing best-in-class care always. Individuality - applying a person-centered approach to meet each individual's abilities, needs and challenges Empowerment - helping all our service-users live their very best life and achieve their optimal potential. What Will Your Responsibilities Be? The delivery of client care needs and the development, implementation and evaluation of Support Plans; Ensure that practices within the service comply with Resilience's policies and procedures, to maintain the highest standards; Liaise with Multi-Disciplinary Teams ('MDTs') when required; Provide support to colleagues within the team setting; Act as a mentor for new staff and foster a positive learning environment; Participate in the development and review of risk assessments and report concerns. What is Required? You will have: FETAC/QQI level 5/Social Care/healthcare assistant qualification or equivalent; Completed or be willing to complete a Patient Manual Handling course; Eligibility to work in Ireland; A strong sense of empathy, flexibility and a team-oriented work ethic. Previous experience working with adults/children with physical, sensory and intellectual disabilities would be an advantage A Full Drivers Licence is desirable. How Will You Benefit? This is your opportunity to: Develop and progress your career through full induction, training and ongoing development. Enjoy excellent rates of pay Resilience Rewards employee discounts e.g discounted health insurance Make your mark as part of a service that is changing the future of care in Ireland. Employee Assistance Programme 24/7 Resilience4Me Health and Well-being Forum Enjoy a personal, one-to-one approach to social care support work. Benefit from the full support of management. Earn from our paid Refer-a-Friend scheme. FETAC/QQI level 5/Social Care/healthcare assistant qualification or equivalent

title: Whiskey & Auction Operations Coordinator
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Who We Are: A small but dynamic business based in Dundalk. Irish Whiskey Auctions is Irelands largest whiskey auction house and shipping hub. Role Summary Irish Whiskey Auctions is looking for a Whiskey & Auction Operations Coordinator to join our team in Dundalk. This is a varied, hands-on role that combines whiskey knowledge, auction and office administration, customer service, logistics and shipping. It would suit someone who enjoys variety in their working day and week, is practical and organised, and is happy to get involved in various aspects of the business. The Role Working as part of our team, you will be involved in the day-to-day operation of our whiskey auctions, including: • Assisting with the administration and running of our whiskey auctions • Receiving and processing whiskey and spirits consignments • Assisting with collections and deliveries using a company van • Preparing items for auction and ensuring accurate records are maintained • Coordinating with couriers and shipping providers • Dealing with customers enquiries by email, phone and in person • Assisting with international and domestic shipments • Stock control • Supporting the wider team with general auction and office administration • Ensuring customers receive a high level of customer service • Working flexibly across different areas of the business as required Key Requirements:- • A full clean driving licence • Countrywide collections using company van. • Good organisational and administrative skills • Excellent attention to detail • Good communication and customer service skills • Good computer skills and the ability to learn new systems • A practical, hands-on approach to work • The ability to work independently while also being a strong team player • A willingness to take on different tasks and adapt as priorities change Existing whiskey knowledge is highly desirable but training will be provided. Knowledge of Irish whiskey, spirits, the drinks industry, logistics, shipping or online auctions would be an advantage. Benefits:- • Competitive Salary • Company pension on completion of probation period • Employee discount • Specialist training where required • Company events To apply: Please send your CV and a short introduction outlining your relevant experience and why the role interests you.

title: Care Assistant
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
The Care Assistant plays a key role in supporting adults with intellectual disabilities to live meaningful, fulfilling lives within a warm and inclusive home environment. Working as part of the house team, the Care Assistant provides person-centred support, contributes to the daily life of the house, and fosters positive relationships with Core Members, colleagues, and volunteers. The role involves practical care, emotional support, participation in community life, and collaboration with the House/Team Leader and wider team to ensure high-quality support in line with L’Arche values. Reporting to: House leader / Team Leader / Deputy Team Leader In Relation to the Core Members Build respectful, trusting, and supportive relationships with each Core Member. Support Core Members in their daily living activities (personal care, meals, household tasks, etc.) while promoting independence. Encourage and support Core Members to make choices and take responsibility in their own lives. Uphold the dignity, self-esteem, and individuality of each person. Follow care plans and Person-Centred Plans (PCPs) in line with HIQA standards. Support Core Members in communication, ensuring their voice is heard and respected. Assist with social, recreational, and community activities in line with Core Members’ interests. Support Core Members to attend appointments (medical, social, etc.) as required. Assist in maintaining accurate and confidential records. Support safe medication practices as directed and trained. Promote a safe, clean, and healthy living environment. In Relation to the Staff Team Work collaboratively as part of the house team, supporting a positive and respectful team culture. Follow guidance from the House/Team Leader and contribute to the smooth running of the house. Participate in team meetings, training, and reflective practice. Communicate effectively with colleagues regarding Core Members’ needs and daily updates. Support new staff and volunteers through welcoming and sharing knowledge of daily routines. Contribute to a supportive and cooperative team environment. Attend support and supervision sessions In Relation to Volunteer Assistants Welcome and include Volunteer Assistants as part of the team. Support volunteers in understanding their role and the daily life of the house. Work alongside volunteers to ensure consistent and supportive care for Core Members. Promote a culture of inclusion, learning, and shared responsibility. In Relation to the House / Community Actively participate in the daily life and routines of the house. Support meal preparation, cleaning, and general household tasks. Contribute to creating a warm, welcoming, and inclusive home environment. Support celebrations, events, and community gatherings. Encourage Core Members’ participation in the wider community. Maintain awareness of health and safety procedures and follow all policies.

title: Logistics Controller
Financial Operations Specialist
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Location: Unit 9, Block D Nutgrove Office Park, Rathfarnham, Dublin, Leinster, Ireland D14 Y382 Roly type: Full-time, permanent – 37.5 hours per week Salary - €36,605 per annum The Financial Operations Specialist plays a key role in ensuring the accuracy, efficiency and continuous improvement of finance operations across billing, revenue management, cash collections and reporting. Working closely with stakeholders across the business, you'll help maintain financial integrity, improve processes and provide insights that support business performance. Key Responsibilities: Financial Analysis & Reporting Reconcile high-volume transactional data to ensure billing accuracy and revenue integrity. Produce regular financial and performance reports, including volume and margin analysis. Monitor billing activity, investigate discrepancies and implement corrective actions. Analyse financial data to identify trends, risks and opportunities. Support month-end and year-end reporting and reconciliation activities. Develop and maintain dashboards, reports and performance metrics. Process Improvement & Systems Identify opportunities to streamline processes, increase automation and improve efficiency. Support finance system enhancements and business improvement projects. Review existing workflows and implement solutions that improve accuracy and reduce manual effort. Act as a subject matter expert, helping the business maximise the value of finance systems and tools. Financial Controls & Compliance Maintain effective financial controls and ensure compliance with company policies. Monitor operational risks and implement control improvements where required. Maintain process documentation and support internal and external audits. Business Partnering Provide data-driven insights to support business planning and decision-making. Act as a key contact for invoicing and finance-related queries. Collaborate with stakeholders to improve processes, reporting and operational effectiveness. Financial Operations Support business-critical Direct Debit collections, managing substantial weekly cash flows. Oversee billing, revenue tracking, financial administration and reporting activities. Ensure timely invoicing and accurate revenue recognition. Maintain the accuracy and consistency of financial data across systems. Skills & Experience Experience in finance operations, financial analysis, billing or revenue management. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail. Advanced Excel skills and experience working with large datasets. Experience producing financial reports, reconciliations and performance analysis. Strong problem-solving and process improvement capabilities. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Experience with financial systems and reporting tools. This is an excellent opportunity for a finance professional who enjoys combining data analysis, operational ownership and continuous improvement to help drive business success.
