title: SAP Solution Architect
description:
Join us in shaping the future of manufacturing technology at Nobia Park!

Do you want to help shape the digital architecture of one of Europe's most automated and sustainable kitchen manufacturing facilities? Our state-of-the-art facility spans 123,000 m², is BREEAM-certified, and features AGVs, ABB robots, and a 2 MW solar power plant. More than just an advanced manufacturing site, Nobia Park is the key part of our digital transformation journey.

We are now looking for a Solution Architect to help drive that journey by designing and governing the solutions that connect our manufacturing, supply chain, and business operations. As new technologies, automation capabilities, and systems continue to be introduced, you will play a key role in ensuring a scalable, connected, and future-ready digital landscape.

About the role

In this role you will help connect our SAP S/4HANA landscape, manufacturing execution systems (MES), and production operations. Working closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, and external partners, you will contribute to strategic development initiatives and the continuous improvement of our digital ecosystem.

Key responsibilities include:

Solution Design & Architecture

    

Design robust, scalable, and secure solutions across SAP and MES environments.

    

Translate business and process requirements into high-level solution designs and architecture.

    

Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture principles and Nobia's digital strategy.

Stakeholder Collaboration

    

Collaborate with business stakeholders, process owners and end users to understand needs and identify improvement opportunities.

    

Work closely with solution engineers, architects and product owners to deliver integrated solutions and support future roadmaps.

    

Ensure alignment across systems, domains and business functions.

Governance & Compliance

    

Ensure solutions meet architectural, security, compliance, and governance standards.

    

Contribute to architectural reviews, change management processes, and technical decision-making.

    

Maintain clear documentation and traceability throughout the solution lifecycle.

Continuous Improvement

    

Stay up to date with emerging technologies and best practices within SAP, MES, and manufacturing technology.

    

Drive modernization, automation, and system integration initiatives across the manufacturing environment.

    

Identify and remove bottlenecks that impact operational efficiency and order fulfillment.

Location: Nobia Park, Jönköping, with an expected on-site presence of at least three days per week. The role includes regular travel to other Nobia locations.

Who you are

To succeed in this role, you are a skilled and proactive Solution Architect who combines a holistic perspective with a strong technical understanding. You can navigate complex environments and turn business needs into practical, long-term solutions.

Collaboration comes naturally to you, and you enjoy building relationships across different functions and levels of the organization. With a structured and analytical mindset, you thrive in environments where continuous improvement, innovation, and cross-functional teamwork are key to success. 

We believe you bring:

    

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.

    

5+ years of experience in Solution Architecture, with a strong focus on SAP Supply chain management and MES integration.

    

Proven experience in designing and deploying solutions in manufacturing environments.

    

Solid understanding of SAP modules (e.g., PP, MM, QM) and interfaces to MES platforms.

    

Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder engagement skills.

    

Ability to balance technical depth with business context in discussions. Preferred Skills:

    

Familiarity with common MES platforms

    

Deep technical knowledge of SAP S/4HANA, particularly within configured products and highly automated make-to-order (MTO) environments.

    

Experience with industrial IoT, edge computing, or data lakes is advantageous.

    

Knowledge of agile methodologies and product-centric delivery models.

    

Certifications such as TOGAF, SAP Certified Technology Associate, or similar are a plus.

About Nobia

Nobia is Europe’s leading kitchen specialist, with strong brands such as Marbodal, HTH, Sigdal, and uno form. With us, you will become part of a modern organization where quality, safety, and continuous improvement are at the core of everything we do. We offer excellent opportunities for both professional and personal development. Curious to learn more? Visit Nobia Park – Jönköping. 

Want to be a part of our journey?

Then we would like to receive your application in English no later than October 18, 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Our recruitment process is competency-based and includes assessments to provide both you and us with the best possible conditions for a successful match. As part of the employment process, you will need to demonstrate your right to work within the EU, for example through a passport or a valid work permit. Background checks and drug screening will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.

If you have any questions, please contact Talent Acquisition Specialist Josephine Tjernlund (josephine.tjernlund@nobia.com). We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Bostadsuthyrare sökes till Lund/Burlöv
description:
Företagsbeskrivning

Heimstaden är ett ledande europeiskt bostadsfastighetsbolag och inventera med 162,000 lägenheter i nio länder med ett fastighetsvärde om 332 miljarder SEK. Vi förvärvar, utvecklar och förvaltar bostäder med ett långsiktigt perspektiv. Vägledda av vårt skandinaviska arv och våra värderingar Dare, Care och Share - uppfyller vi målet om att erbjuda omtänksamma boende som förenklar och förgyller livet för våra kunder. Heimstaden är listade på Nasdaq First North Growth Market. För mer information besök www.heimstaden.com.

På Heimstaden arbetar vi utifrån visionen att förenkla och förgylla kundernas liv genom omtänksamma boenden – Friendly Homes. Vår ambition är att fortsätta växa på ett ansvarsfullt och hållbart sätt tillsammans med våra medarbetare, kunder och samarbetspartners - som alla delar våra värderingar.

Vi söker en Bostadsuthyrare till vårt kontor i Lund, här förvaltar vi hyresrätter i både Lund och Burlöv. I februari 2027 kommer fastighetsportföljen att omfatta totalt 2 006 hyresrätter.

Om rollen

Drivs du av försäljning, kundkontakt och att bygga relationer? Låter det spännande att få hjälpa andra människor att hitta sitt nya boende, att få visa olika typer av bostäder för att matcha kundens behov och se till att kundens nya hem blir precis det som de drömmer om? Då är rollen som Bostadsuthyrare hos Heimstaden, något för dig!

Dina viktigaste arbetsuppgifter som Bostadsuthyrare?

Till vårt gäng i Lund/Burlöv söker vi en resultatorienterad Bostadsuthyrare med fokus på försäljning, visningar och marknadsföring. För att trivas hos oss gillar du att arbeta självständigt och jobba mot de mål som finns uppsatta, en målsättning om att ha noll procent i vakans. För att uppnå vår målsättning är du affärsmässig, skapar förtroende och har ett säljande förhållningssätt till våra hyresgäster och bostadssökande intressenter. Du arbetar aktivt med att vara uppsökande och finnas tillgänglig där Heimstadens kunder finns.

I rollen kommer du att ha många personliga kontakter med både befintliga och potentiella hyresgäster. Du ansvarar för proaktiv kundbearbetning, genomför visningar och upprättar hyresavtal. Som person är du innovativ och van vid att prioritera för att leverera resultat. Du skapar förtroende och förmedlar trygghet i dina kundmöten, då du ofta är den första personliga kontakten med Heimstaden.

Placeringsort för tjänsten är Lund men arbete kommer utföras såväl i Lund som i Burlöv. På orten finns även andra kollegor som arbetar med bostadsuthyrning, fastighetsskötsel, fastighetsförvaltning och en förvaltningskoordinator som tillsammans arbetar för att skapa en affärsmässig förvaltning och erbjuda omtänksamma boenden.

Kravspecifikation

Din profil

    Erfarenhet av relationsskapande försäljning, kundkontakt och service. Vi ser det som meriterande om du tidigare har erfarenhet från bostadsuthyrning och/eller sälj.
    God förmåga att komma överens med och hantera människor i olika situationer. Du är tydlig, håller vad du lovar och håller dig lugn även i stressade situationer.
    Behärskar svenska och engelska, muntligt och skriftligt. Många av våra hyresgäster kommer från världens alla hörn och det är därför meriterande om du behärskar andra språk.
    Är van vid att arbeta digitalt och tar enkelt till dig nya system.
    B-körkort.

Ytterligare information

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 18 oktober 2026. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan därför komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via e-post med anledning av GDPR. Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta områdeschef Catarina Caesar Weston, Catarina.CaesarWeston@heimstaden.com.

Additional information

Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomför vi en bakgrundskontroll innan anställning, via vår samarbetspartner 2Secure. Om du har några frågor kring detta, är du varmt välkommen att kontakta oss!

På Heimstaden är vi övertygade om att mångfald gör oss bättre. Våra inkluderande team speglar de samhällen vi verkar i och bidrar med nytänkande och passion för att skapa framtidens boende och omtänksamma hem.

Våra värderingar är viktiga för oss – Care, Share och Dare. Som medarbetare hos Heimstaden förväntas du bidra till att dessa genomsyrar vårt arbete och våra relationer, både med kollegor och hyresgäster.

På Heimstaden värdesätter vi mångfald och är övertygade om att olika perspektiv leder till bättre beslut och en starkare arbetsmiljö.

title: Senior Lecturer in Textile Technology
description:
The Department of Textile Technology at the Swedish School of Textiles is now seeking a Senior Lecturer in Textile Technology. We have several degree programmes at Bachelor's and Master's levels. The teaching staff often teach in several different programmes and meet students who work with product development in some form. Many students later become employed in the textile industry and appreciate having had teachers with experience in industrial textile product development or production. The department is also seeking a teacher who is interested in research and aims to apply for external education and research funding for continuous development and collaboration with national and international companies and universities.

https://www.hb.se/en/about-ub/work-at-ub/get-to-know-us/work-with-us-at-the-faculty-of-textiles-engineering-and-business/

Your work tasks

You will have the opportunity to work with teaching, course development, course coordiation, and examination at the Bachelor's and Master's levels. This is mainly done within the Bachelor's and Master's programmes as well as freestanding courses in Textile Technology, but can also be in related subject areas and the doctoral programme. The teaching is mainly planned to take place within courses that include prototyping, concept and product development. However, teaching in other areas may also occur when the need arises. You will teach everything from theory to practice and supervise students in practical and theoretical courses at Bachelor's and Master's levels. Several courses contain practical elements that are carried out in interaction with our technicians in the textile labs, where your ability to collaborate will be important.

Based on your own interests and proficiencies, continued academic career advancement in both education and research is possible.

Travel, both nationally and internationally, may occur within the framework of the employment.

Your qualifications

To be considered for this position, you need to have industrial professional experience in textile product development and/or production of textile products. Experience in concept development, methodology for prototyping and of textile-related digital tools are also requirements. The role requires that you have good collaboration skills and that you can communicate well in English both verbally and in writing. You are also administratively skilled and have good computer skills. Furthermore, you have the ability to work independently, for example by taking responsibility for your own courses or running your own projects from start to finish.

You also need to have a doctorate in areas such as industrial design, textile technology, textile or fashion design, materials technology, textile management or other, relevant to the position. In addition, demonstrated teaching expertise is required.

Training in teaching and learning in higher education equivalent to 10 weeks of full-time studies, or equivalent competence, is a general requirement for permanent employment as a teacher. If you do not have the training when you are hired, this can be completed within the framework of the employment during the first two years of employment.

Merits:

    Good ability to communicate in Swedish/another Scandinavian language in speech and writing.
    Professional knowledge in textile technologies.
    Development of functional textile products.
    Familiarity with textile-related legislation, standards, and regulations.
    Experience in market and trend analysis.
    Contacts in the business and industry and experience of collaboration with the surrounding community.
    Experience in concretising sustainability goals related to textiles.
    Employment at another higher education institution.
    Experience of externally funded project applications and project management.
    Experience of research and publication in academic journals after your doctoral thesis defence.
    Experience in educational course and programme development.

Your employment

Type of employment: Permanent employment. A six-month probationary period may be applied.

Scope: 100%

Start date: 11 January 2027 or as agreed upon

Position location: Borås, Sweden

Reference number: PA2026/159

How to apply

Please submit your complete application including registration number and attachments via our recruitment system by 25 October.

https://www.hb.se/en/about-ub/work-at-ub/how-to-apply-for-a-job-with-us/

The University of Borås welcomes applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, recognising that this enriches and strengthens our community. The University of Borås strives for even gender distribution among employees and values diversity.

Want to know more?

Creativity, knowledge, and innovation converge at the Swedish School of Textiles. Our unique lab environments and competencies relate to the majority of the textile value chain. Our close collaboration with both business and industry shapes our educational programmes and as a result, the Swedish School of Textiles is at the core of supplying the knowledge needed in the textile industry. Here, design, engineering, technology, production, business administration, and marketing meet, and that is why our textile research, textile innovation, and textile educational programmes are so strong. This makes the Swedish School of Textiles unique in Europe as well as an internationally recognised educational environment for its work towards a more sustainable textile value chain.

The University of Borås is a governmental authority, which means that you receive particular benefits, generous holiday leave, and a favourable occupational pension.

https://www.hb.se/en/about-ub/work-at-ub/benefits/

https://www.hb.se/en/about-ub/work-at-ub/

Contact those below if you would like to know more about your new job:

https://www.hb.se/en/research/research-portal/researchers/niina-hernandez/, recruiting manager

Union questions can be answered by:

Saco-S: Sunil Kumar and Dawan Mustafa, 033-435 40 00.

OFR/S can be reached via email: mailto:stvidhb@hb.se.

We decline all direct contact with staffing and recruitment companies as well as sellers of recruitment advertisements.

title: Personlig assistent till glad och aktiv 20-åring, Alingsås
description:
Vi söker en engagerad och trygg personlig assistent till en glad och aktiv 20-årig tjej i Alingsås. Hos oss får du ett varierat arbete där ingen dag behöver vara den andra lik – med mycket tid utomhus, aktiviteter, kommunikation och framför allt möjlighet att bidra till en trygg och innehållsrik vardag.

Vad innebär den här tjänsten?

Tjänsten är på deltid och arbetstiderna är förlagda till eftermiddag, kväll, natt och helg.

I rollen stöttar du henne i vardagen med bland annat personlig omvårdnad, kommunikation, aktiviteter och tillsyn.

Hon är en social, glad och aktiv tjej som gärna är ute oavsett väder. Att kasta boll, promenera och bada är några av aktiviteterna hon tycker om. Som assistent är du med och deltar i aktiviteterna – du stöttar, inspirerar och finns nära till hands när det behövs.

Kommunikation är en viktig del av arbetet. Hon har inget tal, men visar tydligt vad hon vill och förstår vad du säger. Med tiden blir du ett viktigt stöd för henne i kommunikationen med andra. Därför är det meriterande om du har erfarenhet av AKK (alternativ och kompletterande kommunikation) eller av att använda bilder och tecken som stöd.

Hon bor tillsammans med sin familj och deras hund i Alingsås. I arbetet ingår även vissa hushållsuppgifter som är kopplade till hennes funktionsvariation.

Vem tror vi passar hos oss?

Om du tycker om att vara aktiv, skapa trygghet och bygga en fin relation med en annan människa kan det här vara en roll för dig. Du behöver inte kunna allt från början – det viktigaste är att du är engagerad, nyfiken och villig att lära känna personen du arbetar med.

Kunden ser gärna att du:

    

Är kvinna

    

Är aktiv och tycker om att vara utomhus

    

Har goda kunskaper i svenska, både tal och skrift

    

Tål pälsdjur

    

Har kunskap eller erfarenhet av funktionsvariationer, gärna autism

    

kan arbeta dag, kväll, natt och helg

    

En merit om du har B-körkort

Övrig information

Anställningsform: Så länge assistansuppdraget varar

Omfattning: Deltid

Arbetstider: Varierade arbetstider, schemalagd på eftermiddag, kväll, natt och helg.

Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse

Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning och har kollektivavtal. Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.

Inför en eventuell anställning ska du kunna påvisa att du är svensk medborgare, EU/EES medborgare eller har permanent uppehållstillstånd. Detta genom att uppvisa giltiga handlingar som styrker detta.

Sista ansökningsdag: 2026-10-30

Madeleine Jönsson, Rekryteringsspecialist, 010-130 3249

Hicham Hussein, Verksamhetschef , 010-130 3616

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Satin söker erfaren verksamhetschef till skyddat boende och stödboende
description:
Om oss

Vi på Satin AB erbjuder placering i skyddat boende och stödboende för människor från hela landet. Vårt mål är att utifrån varje individs särskilda förutsättningar erbjuda möjlighet till ett tryggt hem, personlig utveckling och en god framtid. Stödet erbjuds utifrån vår kompetens kring social problematik, våld i nära relation, hedersvåld och familjebehandling. Vi är HBTQI-certifierade.

Satin är ett systerbolag till Funkisgruppen AB, som utöver skyddat boende erbjuder insatser enligt LSS och SoL, så som daglig verksamhet, boendestöd, ledsagning och avlösning.

Våra verksamheter finns från Stockholm till Skåne, med huvudkontor i Solna.

Om rollen

Vi växer och är ständigt under utveckling, vi söker därför en engagerad verksamhetschef till Malmö som vill vara med och utveckla vår verksamhet. Rollen innebär utrymme att driva verksamheten framåt, utveckla affären och bygga upp, anpassa och leda arbetet tillsammans med våra stöd- och specialistfunktioner samt chefskollegor.

I vår verksamhet i Malmö tar vi emot människor som har behov av skydd eller stöd enligt beslut från socialtjänsten. Våra boende finns i egna lägenheter och vi finns där för att stötta i processen mot en ny vardag.

Teamet består av 17 behandlingsassistenter och en samordnare som stöttar i den operativa planeringen.

Vi har tillstånd från IVO för att bedriva skyddat boende.

Vi söker dig som vill:

    Vara en nyckelperson i vår fortsatta utveckling på marknaden
    Upparbeta och behålla goda kontakter med våra kunder
    Ansvara för personal, ekonomi och verksamhet
    Ha ett helhetsansvar för att driva och utveckla din enhet
    Ingå i en grupp engagerade chefer med nära stödfunktioner
    Vara en viktig del i vårt utvecklings- och förbättringsarbete

Som chef hos oss ansvarar du för att säkerställa en trygg arbetsmiljö, en effektiv organisation, säker dokumentation och en god kvalitet.

Du ansvarar för att säkerställa att vi:

    Erbjuder ett tryggt och stabilt stöd i vardagen och hjälper klienter att bearbeta sina upplevelser
    Upprätthåller säkerhetsrutiner för att skydda klienter
    Samverkar med myndigheter som polis, domstol, skola och sjukvård samt övriga instanser
    Stöttar i arbetet mot ett självständigt liv; hjälper till med permanent boende, skyddade personuppgifter och en fungerande vardag

Vi söker dig som:

    Har en socionomexamen
    Har minst 3 års erfarenhet av ansvar för personal, ekonomi och verksamhet
    Har erfarenhet av att leda liknande typer av verksamheter
    Har ett stort engagemang för personer i behov av stöd
    Har B-körkort
    Vi lägger därtill stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet!
    Det är starkt meriterande om du tidigare stått som föreståndare för skyddat boende hos IVO.

Är du vår nästa kollega? Välkommen med din ansökan!

Vi kommer ha löpande intervjuer under processen.

Vi undanber oss kontakt av bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag.

title: Key User
description:
About the Role

As a Key User, you are responsible for supporting and developing our warehouse management systems and related business applications. You will play a central role in ensuring stable system operations, supporting end users, driving improvements, and participating in customer onboarding and implementation projects.

The role combines operational support with system administration, testing, project work, and continuous improvement initiatives. You will work closely with both internal stakeholders and external partners to ensure successful system performance and business development.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Operational support - providing first-line support for business-critical warehouse systems, troubleshooting incidents, and ensuring timely resolution of user issues

• System administration - maintaining master data, warehouse configurations, layouts, and supporting warehouse devices, printers, terminals, and related technologies

• Integrations and data flows - monitoring interfaces and electronic message flows between systems and identifying and resolving integration-related issues

• Development and testing - gathering business requirements, coordinating development activities with vendors and internal teams, and performing functional, integration, and user acceptance testing

• Customer onboarding - configuring systems and integrations, validating setups through testing, and supporting operational teams during customer implementations and go-lives

• Projects and business improvements - participating in warehouse relocations, customer implementation projects, system migrations, and continuous improvement initiatives

Your Profile

To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

• Experience from warehouse, logistics, supply chain, or similar operational environments

• Strong understanding of warehouse and logistics processes

• Experience working with warehouse management systems or other business-critical applications

• Knowledge of system integrations and electronic data flows

• Experience with testing, documentation, and end-user support

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• The ability to collaborate effectively across operational and technical teams

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken



Experience with one or more of the following systems is considered an advantage:

• Logius / Proweb

• Astro

• Business Central

• Glue

• OMS

• Semarchy

• nShift

• Jira

• ServiceNow

• Power BI

• VoiceLink



We Value Your Personal Qualities

As a person, you are structured, proactive, and service-minded. You enjoy solving problems and have the ability to balance operational support with long-term improvement initiatives.

You thrive in a fast-paced environment, take ownership of your responsibilities, and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously. At the same time, you are a team player who understands the importance of collaboration and knowledge sharing to achieve sustainable results.

Additional Information

We are committed to maintaining a safe working environment and conduct background checks as well as random alcohol and drug testing. We are covered by the Swedish Transport Workers' Union collective agreement and offer wellness benefits and employee discounts through Epassi.

title: Childcare work in Gröndal
description:
Nanny Position – Stockholm’s International Nanny Agency

Location: Gröndal - 5-minute walk from the bus station

Stockholm’s International Nanny Agency is currently recruiting an experienced, reliable, and caring nanny to support a 5-year-old boy with special needs and a 2-year old-girl in a long-term position with a family in Gröndal.

Position Overview

    Child/ren: 5-year-old boy with autism level two, and a 2-year-old girl
    Start Date: As soon as possible
    Duration: Long-term

Responsibilities

    Engage him in activities designed to improve his communication skills and attention
    Prepare snacks and simple meals as needed
    Light chores in the house
    Organize playtime for both children; indoor and outdoor
    Provide a safe, nurturing, and stimulating environment for both



Schedule & Hours

    Initial Period: As soon as possible
    Ongoing: 2-3 times per week
    Typical Hours: 15:30 - 18:30, occasionally longer

Additional Details

    Language Skills: English, Swedish or Portuguese - English is preferred
    Allergies: None. The mother will provide more information about her son’s food preferences
    Pets: None

Candidate Requirements

    Experience with children in this age group  
    Experience working with children with special needs; training or previous experience supporting children with autism is a strong advantage
    Fluent in English
    Reliable, active, creative, patient, and able to commit long-term
    Flexibility  



Preferred Qualifications

    CPR and First Aid certification (or willingness to obtain)
    Previous training related to autism or special-needs childcare
    Clear background check and strong references
    Flexible availability and a nurturing attitude

title: Vi söker två förebyggande socionomer till Förskoleförvaltningen
description:
Vill du göra skillnad på riktigt? Vill du vara med och bygga sociala förskoleteam i stadens förskolor? Förskoleförvaltningen i Göteborgs Stad söker nu ytterligare två förebyggande socionomer som vill vara med och utveckla nya arbetssätt för att stärka barns rättigheter och livsvillkor. Vårt mål är att stärka och kvalitetshöja förskolans verksamhet så att alla barn ges möjlighet att växa upp i trygghet med goda livsvillkor och ett liv fritt från kriminalitet och våld.

Som förebyggande socionom blir du en del av vårt sociala förskoleteam, som ingår i barnhälsans stödteam tillsammans med specialpedagoger, psykologer och logopeder. Tillsammans arbetar ni hälsofrämjande och förebyggande med förskolan som främsta arena.

Uppdraget handlar främst om att bidra till att öka tidiga insatser för barn och familj samt stärka utvecklingsarbetet i förskoleförvaltningen. Detta innebär till exempel att du kommer arbeta med generella förebyggande insatser genom att stötta rektor och medarbetare i förskola. Du kommer bidra i enskilda ärenden kring barn och familj i riskzon. I arbetet ingår även samverkan med socialtjänsten, leda föräldragrupper, leda SIP-processer (Samordnad Individuell Plan), samt uppsökande arbete för fler barn i förskola.

Dina arbetsuppgifter:

• Handledning och metodstöd till rektorer och pedagoger för att identifiera barn i utsatthet.

• Bidra med kompetenshöjande insatser i syfte att stärka barns rättigheter och skapa goda livsvillkor.

• Bidra till goda relationer mellan vårdnadshavare och förskola, bland annat genom att motivera vårdnadshavare att ta del av stöd och samhällsservice.

• Stötta rektor och pedagoger vid och inför svåra samtal med vårdnadshavare inklusive utvecklingssamtal.

• Vägleda förskolans personal vid orosanmälan och anmälningsmöten samt kring socialtjänstens uppdrag.

• Leda SIP-möten och bidra med kunskap om SIP-processen.

• Samverka nära med andra professioner inom förskolan, inom staden och med externa aktörer.

Det här uppdraget passar dig som är utbildad socionom, trivs med att arbeta i team och vill vara med och forma nya arbetssätt för att skapa tryggare och mer jämlika livsvillkor för Göteborgs barn.

Utgångspunkt för tjänsten är på Gamlestads Torg 5, arbetet sker verksamhetsnära främst på förskolor i Nordost men kan även omfatta förskolor i övriga stadsområden.

Kvalifikationer

För den här tjänsten söker vi dig som har:

• Socionomexamen

• Minst två års yrkeserfarenhet inom socialtjänsten barn och unga

• Erfarenhet av att leda möten utifrån SIP-processen

• Kunskap om hedersrelaterat våld och förtryck, samt våld i nära relation

Det är även meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:

• Att handleda och ge metodstöd

• Att arbeta med föräldraskapsstöd

• Svåra samtal med vårdnadshavare

• Att utbilda i SIP

• Utbildning i Traumamedveten omsorg

• Arbete inom förskola/skola

Du behöver vara en trygg, lyhörd och kommunikativ person som kan förmedla information och idéer på ett tydligt sätt och anpassa dig efter mottagare, målgrupp och situation. Du trivs med att samarbeta, lyssnar in andras perspektiv och visar intresse och respekt. Du förstår ditt uppdrag i teamet och har god samarbetsförmåga, samtidigt tar du initiativ och kan arbeta självständigt, och har förmågan att fatta beslut inom ramen för ditt uppdrag. Rollen kräver också att du är pedagogisk och har förståelse för människors olika behov och förutsättningar, där du kan förmedla ditt budskap till mottagaren och uppmuntrar till dialog, delaktighet och engagemang.



Intervjuer är planerade att genomföras vecka 43.

Övrigt

Har du skyddade personuppgifter ska du inte ansöka via rekryteringssystemet. Kontakta i stället Göteborgs Stads kontaktcenter på 031-365 00 00. Förklara ditt ärende och be att bli kopplad till HR-specialist på enheten kompetens och arbetsmarknad. I övrigt tar vi endast emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringssystem.

I den här rekryteringen efterfrågar vi inte personligt brev. I stället får du möjlighet att beskriva din kompetens inom relevanta områden genom att besvara våra urvalsfrågor.

Enligt lag kan vi inför anställning be dig visa upp ett utdrag ur belastningsregistret. För vissa tjänster kan även ytterligare kontroller bli aktuella.

Vi vet att du gör ett bättre jobb om du mår bra, både på jobbet och på fritiden. Här har vi samlat några av de förmåner vi erbjuder dig som jobbar hos oss: Förmåner

Göteborgs Stad tillämpar individuell och differentierad lönesättning. Här kan du få mer information om bland annat lönestatistik: Lön och ersättningar

Inför denna rekrytering har vi tagit ställning till val av rekryteringskanaler. Vi undanber oss därför erbjudanden om kompetensförmedling, annonserings- och rekryteringstjänster.

Om Oss

På förskoleförvaltningen ger du barnen möjligheter till en bra framtid. Varje dag!

Vi ansvarar för utbildning och omsorg för cirka 25 000 barn i närmare 350 kommunala förskolor. Förvaltningen har omkring 7 000 medarbetare fördelat på cirka 75 yrken. Tillsammans arbetar vi mot samma mål - att utveckla en rolig, trygg och lärorik förskola för alla barn i Göteborg.

Läs gärna mer om vårt arbete på vår hemsida: Jobba i förskoleförvaltningen - Göteborgs Stad

Välkommen till världens viktigaste jobb!

title: Global Product Manager Deep Automation
description:
Do you want to help shape the future of autonomous mining and accelerate the transformation toward safer, more productive underground operations?



At Epiroc, we are expanding the boundaries of automation and digitalization, and we are looking for a commercially minded Global Product Manager who is passionate about turning customer needs into innovative business opportunities. This is a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of mining technology, driving the development and commercialization of advanced autonomous loader solutions used by customers around the world.



Join our team

You will join the Underground Division's Marketing organization and become part of a collaborative global team focused on Deep Automation solutions for underground loaders.



Working closely with colleagues across product management, R&D, sales, operations, and customer centers worldwide, you will contribute to some of Epiroc's most innovative and strategically important technologies.



Your Mission

Deep Automation combines advanced systems, software, and autonomous machines to create automation solutions for material handling in underground mining. As Global Product Manager, Deep Automation - Loaders, you will define, drive, and develop products and services that help customers improve safety, productivity, and operational performance through automation and digitalization.



You will be responsible for the entire product lifecycle—from identifying customer and market needs to developing business opportunities, driving commercialization, and ensuring successful market adoption. Working closely with customers and colleagues across R&D, sales, and operations, you will shape product strategy, develop business and pricing models, support marketing activities, train the global sales organization, and lead products from development through launch and continuous improvement.



Your responsibilities include:

    Defining product strategies and roadmaps based on customer and market insights.
    Identifying and developing new business opportunities and business cases.
    Driving product development, launch, and commercialization activities.
    Supporting global sales teams through training, value propositions, and marketing initiatives.
    Engaging directly with customers to understand needs and support their automation journey.
    Monitoring product performance and driving continuous improvements in safety, quality, and customer value.



Your Profile

We are looking for a proactive and commercially minded professional who enjoys identifying opportunities, influencing stakeholders, and turning ideas into successful products.You thrive in collaborative environments, excel at collaborating across a global and diverse organization, and are comfortable engaging with customers as well as technical experts.



To succeed in this role, you likely have:

    A university degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field.
    At least 5 years of experience in product management, business development, sales, project management, operations, or a similar commercial role.
    Experience working in industries such as mining, industrial automation, construction, robotics, manufacturing, or related sectors.
    Strong business acumen and the ability to identify, evaluate, and develop commercial opportunities.
    Experience working in cross-functional and international environments.
    Excellent communication and presentation skills in English.



Experience with automation, digital solutions, software-based products, or mining applications is considered an advantage. Fluency in Spanish is also considered a plus.



Location and Travel

This position is located in Örebro, Sweden.

We offer a flexible hybrid work environment that promotes a healthy balance between professional and personal life.

Occasional global travel is required.



Why Epiroc?

By joining our team, you can expect an atmosphere of creativity, innovation, and workplace diversity. You will be part of a skilled, positive, and ambitious team working in a creative environment shaped by our values of Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation. With colleagues from more than 100 nationalities, we offer a truly global and diverse workplace where continuous development is encouraged and supported.



To support your journey, we offer a competitive Total Rewards Package, including:

        Global career opportunities
        Learning & Development programs
        Benefits package, including variable compensation (bonus)
        Flexible work culture promoting balance and well-being
        Global Parental Leave Policy
        Community involvement



Application

Please submit your application in English as soon as possible, but no later than October 11th, 2026.

title: Finance Manager, RFM, Resins
description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Cytiva, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Working at Cytiva means being at the forefront of providing new solutions to transform human health. Our incredible customers undertake life-saving activities ranging from fundamental biological research to developing innovative vaccines, new medicines, and cell and gene therapies.

At Cytiva you will be able to continuously improve yourself and us – working on challenges that truly matter with people that care for each other, our customers, and their patients. Take your next step to an altogether life-changing career.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Finance Manager is responsible for driving financial planning, forecasting, and performance management across the business unit. The role partners closely with business leaders to support decision-making, optimize resource allocation, and ensure delivery of sustainable growth and productivity initiatives.

This position reports to the Sr Director, Finance for Resins & Technologies and is part of the Finance organization located in Uppsala, Sweden. This is an on-site role.

What you'll do:

    Business Unit Finance Processes Leadership
    Lead monthly forecasting, Annual Operating Plan and monthly closing processes; analyze revenue, margin, operating expenses and operating profit performance; deliver business reviews; drive forecast accuracy; support KPI development and performance analytics.
    Business Unit Strategic Investment & Capital Portfolio Finance
    Provide financial oversight for capital investments including capacity expansion, productivity, automation and growth projects. Partner with the Global PMO Leader, lead capital planning and forecasting, monitor spending and provide portfolio governance.
    Review and challenge capital investment proposals. Evaluate NPV, IRR, payback and ROI. Support capital approval processes and provide recommendations on project prioritization and capital allocation.
    Track delivery of approved financial benefits, conduct post-investment reviews, develop portfolio dashboards and drive accountability for investment returns.
    Business Partnership
    Partner closely with the Business Unit CFO on FP&A activities including forecasting, planning, and business performance management, while serving as the primary finance partner to the Global PMO Leader for strategic investment planning, capital governance, and value realization.
    DBS & Continuous Improvement
    Drive simplification and standardization of FP&A and capital governance processes while supporting DBS and productivity initiatives.
    Partner with local and global stakeholders to identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and digital solutions to enhance financial planning, reporting, forecasting, and decision-making processes.

Who you are:

    Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or a related field.
    Multiple years of experience in FP&A, forecasting, annual operating planning and business performance management within an industrial environment.
    Experience evaluating capital investments and business cases using financial valuation methodologies such as NPV, IRR, payback and ROI.
    Advanced Excel skills and experience working with ERP and financial planning systems such as Oracle, SAP, OneStream or Business Objects.
    Fluent in English and Swedish, both written and spoken.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

    Leading projects, workstreams or cross-functional teams.
    Supporting capital portfolio management, manufacturing investments, large-scale productivity programs or continuous improvement initiatives.
    A strong interest in leveraging AI, automation and digital technologies to improve finance processes, increase productivity and enhance decision-making.

You are highly analytical and business-oriented, with the ability to translate financial insights into impactful decisions. You build strong partnerships across functions, communicate complex topics with clarity, and effectively drive results through collaboration and influence. You thrive in a continuous improvement environment, embrace change, and are motivated by creating value for the business.

title: Field Engineering Manager
description:
Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.

If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow.

At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.

Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.

Place of work: Boden

What you’ll do

Right now, we are looking for a Field Engineering Manager – STM for our Engineering team within Project Delivery. This is a site-based role in Boden, supporting the construction of our large-scale greenfield steel plant.

As Field Engineering Manager, you will be the key technical link between the design organization, construction teams, EPCM partners, and contractors. Your focus will be on making engineering work in the field: resolving technical and constructability issues, managing field changes, and ensuring construction teams have the right information and engineering support to keep execution moving safely and efficiently.

Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.

    Act as the primary on-site engineering contact, connecting design teams with construction and contractor organizations
    Review drawings, specifications, vendor documentation, and technical information to identify and resolve field and constructability issues
    Manage Site Technical Queries (STQs) and Requests for Information (RFIs), ensuring timely and clear resolution
    Lead constructability reviews together with construction teams, contractors, and design engineers
    Coordinate technical matters with EPCM partners, OEMs, procurement, QA/QC, HSE, and Project Controls
    Manage field changes, technical deviations, Site Instructions, redlines, and as-built processes through the appropriate approval routes
    Support construction planning and look-ahead activities by identifying engineering constraints and risks to schedule
    Lead and coordinate site-based field and discipline engineers, providing technical direction, support, and development

What you’ll bring

You’re curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You’re not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking and you treat others with respect while doing it. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust, and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best.

For this role, we are looking for someone who combines strong engineering judgement with a practical understanding of construction. You should be comfortable being close to the work in the field, making decisions, resolving technical issues, and working across organizational boundaries to keep construction progressing.

Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below

    Relevant experience in field engineering, project engineering, or engineering-construction interface roles within large-scale industrial or construction projects
    Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Structural, Mechanical, or another relevant engineering discipline
    Experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering activities in a site-based construction environment
    Strong ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, vendor documentation, and construction methods
    Good understanding of RFI/STQ processes, field changes, document control, redlines, and as-built documentation
    Experience working across design, construction, contractors, QA/QC, HSE, procurement, and Project Controls
    Strong practical problem-solving skills with the ability to develop solutions that can be implemented in the field
    Experience leading or coordinating engineering teams, with strong communication skills in English

Benefits at Stegra

At Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.

You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.

This is Stegra

Stegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.

By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.

Our Boden Site

Our Boden site is located just west of Boden City, right in the heart of a growing green industrial hub in Northern Sweden. It’s where we’re building one of the world’s most modern, sustainable steel plants—designed with safety, efficiency, and people in mind. With just a 10-minute commute from town, you'll be close to both cutting-edge technology and the everyday convenience of living near nature, schools, and community life.

title: Hub General Manager
description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:

Lead the future of PSD Hub ÖrebroAre you an experienced leader who thrives in complex, global environments and enjoys bringing people, functions, and strategies together? We are looking for a Hub General Manager to lead Parts & Services Division (PSD) Hub Örebro through an important transformation journey. This is a highly visible leadership role where you will bring together approximately 200 employees and 30 managers across multiple functions, strengthening collaboration, alignment, and engagement while helping shape the hub's future as a Solution Acceleration Center. The role reports to Vice President Operations, Christel Fuellenbach.



Join our teamPSD Hub Örebro brings together a broad range of capabilities, including engineering, technical service, service training, marketing, pricing, communications, e-commerce, and operational support functions. As Hub General Manager, you will act as the senior focal point for the hub and collaborate closely with divisional leadership, global stakeholders, HR, unions, Product Companies, and Customer Centers worldwide. The role is also part of PSD's global hub network, working closely with colleagues in Nanjing, Nashik, Garland, and Johannesburg.



Your missionYour mission is to create one aligned and high-performing hub organization while driving the transformation toward a stronger business-oriented and market-connected operating model.



Key priorities include:




    Building collaboration and a strong "one hub, one team" culture across functions and locations.
    Leading through influence in an environment with primarily indirect leadership responsibilities.
    Acting as the main interface between the hub and key stakeholders across the business.
    Strengthening cross-functional cooperation between engineering, operations, marketing, sourcing, and customer-facing organizations.
    Supporting the development of structures that improve value creation, revenue visibility, and solution commercialization.
    Driving organizational change while maintaining employee engagement and trust.  



Your profileWe believe you are an experienced leader who enjoys creating clarity, bringing people together, and driving change in complex organizations.



You have likely:




    Successfully led organizational transformation and change initiatives.
    Experience from large, cross-functional, and international organizations.
    Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build trust across different levels of an organization.
    A collaborative leadership style with excellent communication skills.
    Experience from service, engineering, operations, aftermarket, or related business environments.



Experience from matrix organizations, indirect leadership, or commercial transformation is highly valued.



We know that great candidates do not always meet every single requirement. If this role interests you and you believe your experience can contribute to our success, we encourage you to apply.



Our leadership expectationsAt Epiroc, we expect our leaders to be inspirers, accelerators, and new thinkers. We value leaders who lead by example and have the courage to challenge the status quo. Safety and sustainability are our top priorities, and we expect our leaders to actively promote safety, inclusion, and diversity, while also prioritizing the well-being and continuous development of our employees. We are looking for you who have the courage to believe in new ideas and see opportunities where others see challenges.



Why Epiroc?By joining our team, you’ll make a big difference in the energy transition. At Epiroc, we take pride in being passionate innovators, driving the change toward a brighter future for both people and the planet. Guided by our values of Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation, we foster a culture of trust, growth, and lasting impact.



To support your journey, we offer a competitive Total Rewards Package, including:




    Global career opportunities
    Learning & Development programs
    Benefits package, including variable compensation (bonus)
    Flexible work culture promoting balance and well-being
    Global Parental Leave Policy
    Community involvement



Location and otherÖrebro, Sweden. Occasional international travel.



Application and contact informationWe encourage you to submit your application through our online career site as soon as possible, but no later than October 31, 2026. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.



We are committed to a thorough recruitment process, including interviews, reference checks and assessments. To ensure a safe working environment, we conduct identity checks and drug and alcohol screening. Our process is designed to be fair and inclusive; you can expect transparent communication and a balanced evaluation of your skills and experience.



For questions about the position, please contact:Hiring Manager: Christel Fuellenbach, Vice President Operations, christel.fuellenbach@epiroc.comRecruitment Specialist: Otto Wetterström, otto.wetterstrom@external.epiroc.com
