title: Team Lead Content Strategist 100%
description:
**About notus**

At notus, we build content engines for B2B founders and executives. We help them use the best marketing asset there is — people — through personal-brand-led content that communicates expertise, builds trust and supports business growth.
Our roots are in New York City, where our founder, Marvin Sanginés, began documenting his journey building a marketing agency in 2020. He found that his own personal brand created the most value and opportunity, so he set out to offer clients the same. A few years on, we work with founders and executives across an international portfolio.

Our international portfolio spans wealth and asset-management technology, enterprise B2B software, fintech and digital assets, AI and technology, hospitality, and private equity.

notus is young and growing fast. Our team is made up of driven people with a love for content, an eye for detail and a lot of positive energy. In this role you get to learn from successful founders and executives every day, and we support you in developing your own professional profile too, subject to client confidentiality.

**The role**

We're looking for a Team Lead Content Strategist: a senior content-strategy role that supports our leadership on strategy, quality and delivery across our international, English-language client portfolio. You'll help coordinate a pod of 3–5 content strategists and take strategic responsibility for a portfolio of C-level clients, working closely with and reporting to our COO. Your focus is the day-to-day content strategy, quality and coordination that deliver them.

Coordinate the pod
- Provide strategy input and quality assurance on the work of 3–5 content strategists, supporting final approvals before work reaches a client.
- Run 1:1s, performance check-ins, team development and skill-building.
- Support interviewing and onboarding of new strategists.

Senior client responsibility
- Take senior strategic responsibility for a portfolio of C-level clients: media strategy, content architecture, editorial direction and the recurring content calls the material comes from
- Write and edit in the voice of founders, CFOs, CROs, fund managers and platform executives, at publication standard, for professional and institutional audiences.
- Run onboarding and deep-dive workshops, and quarterly and annual performance reviews with C-suite clients.
- Attend client events and give content direction on site.
- Grow the offering
- Help extend client strategy beyond LinkedIn into multi-channel media strategies.
- Support GTM engagements — outreach and lead generation as an extension of the content engine — in partnership with the GTM team.
- Support the wider book
- Work alongside the COO on oversight across notus's wider portfolio, acting as an early point of contact when an account needs a new strategy and preparing options for leadership.
- Contribute to pre-sales: outreach, pitch decks and proposals.
- Codify what works into frameworks, templates, QA rubrics, onboarding processes and written standards the wider strategist group works from.

**What you bring**

Essential
- At least 3 years in a client-facing professional role within financial services and/or B2B software and platform businesses. You will be writing in the voice of finance and platform executives and judging whether a claim is accurate before it publishes under their name — domain literacy here is the quality control.
- A portfolio of published, executive-voice thought-leadership content for founders and C-level clients. Please submit only work you are authorised to disclose.
- Experience coordinating or supporting a delivery team, including quality assurance of the team's client-facing output.
- Written English at publication standard for North American, UK and international professional audiences (C2 level or demonstrably equivalent professional proficiency), evidenced by a portfolio of published English-language executive content.
- Experience handling confidential, regulated or commercially sensitive subject matter responsibly, including recognising when content needs compliance review.
- Willingness to occasionally join client calls in the evening (CET) to accommodate international clients.
- Working fluency with LinkedIn as a B2B distribution channel and with analytics-led content iteration.

Strong advantages
- Agency or consultancy experience across a large client portfolio.
- A formal finance qualification: FINRA SIE or Series 7, CFA-level study, or equivalent.
- Direct sector experience in wealth or asset-management technology, fintech or digital assets, enterprise SaaS, AI, hospitality technology or private equity.
- Experience with paid amplification alongside organic content, and hands-on outbound or demand-generation experience (Sales Navigator, HeyReach or similar).
- Experience extending executive strategy beyond LinkedIn into other channels.
German or other additional languages are an asset, not a requirement. This role serves our English-language international portfolio; our DACH clients are served by German-speaking strategists and copywriters.

**Working style**

- Detail-oriented, with high personal quality standards.
- Able to hold and switch between different executives' voices, industries and risk tolerances.
- A proactive, reliable communicator.
- Genuinely curious about business, finance and technology.
- Open to feedback and iteration without ego, and committed to consistently high-quality work and continuous improvement.

**What we offer**

- A permanent, full-time position with notus GmbH (Schweiz).
- An international, collaborative team of experienced professionals.
- Access to all internal training resources and courses.
- Direct exposure to senior executives and international B2B brands.
- A quality-focused working environment that wants to see you succeed and grow.
- A permanent 100% position with a discretionary bonus for introducing new business under a documented bonus policy.

**How to apply**

Please send:
- Your CV.
- A portfolio of published executive-voice content in English, noting which pieces you wrote, edited or approved and for what kind of client. Please submit only work you are authorised to disclose — no confidential, privileged, personal or non-public client information.
- A short note on your experience inside financial services or B2B software, and how you use it in content work.
- A short note on your experience coordinating or quality-assuring other strategists' work.
- A 3–5 minute Loom video or an equivalent written response covering: (1) who you are and (2) why you are a fit.
- Please name 1–3 professional references (former employers or clients) with their name, your relationship, and a contact email or attach written references.
- Your availability and salary expectations.
- Please start your application with the words CONTENT ENGINE so we know you read the brief properly.

We look forward to finding someone we can grow with long-term.

Country and place of work: Switzerland — home office within Switzerland. EU/EFTA nationals are welcome to apply and must be resident in Switzerland, or willing to relocate to Switzerland before starting.
Work model: Remote within Switzerland (home office).
Employment type: Permanent, full-time position at 100%.

EU/EFTA nationals may take up employment subject to the applicable Swiss registration or residence-permit requirements. Applicants who are not EU/EFTA nationals are subject to the applicable Swiss admission and work-permit requirements. A job offer alone does not guarantee the issuance of a Swiss work permit.

Equal opportunity
notus GmbH assesses applicants on job-related qualifications and experience and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified candidates. Reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process can be requested from the contact below.

Data protection
Personal data submitted during the recruitment process is processed by notus GmbH (Schweiz) for recruitment and employment-related purposes in accordance with our privacy notice: https://www.notus.xyz/privacy-policy. Please do not submit confidential information belonging to third parties. The role helps teams determine the appropriate governance approach for PSPs, diagnostic services, and other patient-facing support, ensuring that the right Medical, Ethics & Compliance, Pharmacovigilance, Quality, Regulatory, Privacy, Legal, Digital/DD&T, Access, Procurement, and Vendor Management reviews are built into the process where relevant.

The role balances compliance rigor with practical execution, enabling responsible innovation through simple tools, templates, clear accountabilities, and consistent ways of working across markets. Working closely with Strategic Portfolio Division (SPD), Marketing and Commercial Excellence (MCE), and local market organizations, the role helps translate enterprise governance standards into compliant local execution aligned to patient journey needs, healthcare-system realities, and country-specific regulatory requirements. It does not own Patient Services strategy, asset-level launch planning, or local program delivery; instead, it provides the governance standards, risk-management framework, and advisory support needed for compliant, scalable, and patient-centric execution globally

The role also serves as a key Medical Governance Office partner to Digital/DD&T and Patient Solutions stakeholders, ensuring that digital patient services, technology-enabled patient support programs, patient-facing platforms, and emerging AI-enabled solutions are governed through appropriate risk-based oversight, data governance, privacy, security, quality, and compliance frameworks. This includes helping define governance standards for increasingly integrated digital and non-digital patient support ecosystems. Recent governance discussions have emphasized the need to synchronize digital and non-digital patient service governance and clarify ownership across overlapping governance domains.

How you will contribute
- Establish, maintain, and evolve enterprise governance standards for Patient Services to ensure consistent quality, transparency, accountability, appropriate oversight, and compliance across markets.
- Define practical decision criteria and review tools that help teams determine whether an activity should follow PSP governance, diagnostic service governance, or another appropriate patient support governance pathway.
- Partner with SPD, MCE, LOC Patient Services leaders, and country organizations to establish governance frameworks that enable compliant local implementation of patient support solutions while maintaining alignment with enterprise standards, local patient journey requirements, evolving regulations, and global risk-management expectations.
- Define lifecycle governance expectations for Patient Services and PSPs, from concept/intake through review, approval, implementation readiness, monitoring, change management, and close-out or retirement, ensuring clear documentation and accountability at each stage.
- Translate governance expectations into usable operating materials, including intake questions, checklists, templates, documentation requirements, SOP/standard inputs, training materials, and knowledge-management resources.
- Enable consistent governance review by coordinating required functional input from Medical, Ethics & Compliance, Pharmacovigilance, Quality, Regulatory, Privacy, Legal, Digital/DD&T, Access, Procurement, Vendor Management, and local Medical teams where relevant, ensuring governance decisions appropriately reflect both enterprise risk considerations and local execution realities.
- Assess new, changing, or scaled Patient Services and related patient support activities to determine the appropriate governance pathway, required functional review, documentation expectations, and oversight needs.
- Maintain visibility of emerging patient support models across markets, identifying trends, common risks, and opportunities for harmonization, simplification, and scalable governance approaches that balance global consistency with necessary local flexibility.
- Define enterprise expectations for third-party governance in Patient Services and PSPs, including role clarity, qualification expectations, training, documentation, oversight, issue escalation, and performance visibility, while local or program owners remain accountable for vendor execution and day-to-day management.
- Provide governance advisory support for new, changing, or scaled patient support models, including launch-related PSPs, diagnostic services, access support, treatment-start services, and home care or monitoring models, while not owning asset strategy, launch execution, or local implementation.
- Build and maintain governance visibility for Patient Services and related patient solutions through inventories, repositories, documentation standards, review status tracking, issue visibility, follow-up actions, and leadership-ready summaries.
- Support audit readiness, governance reviews, risk assessments, gap analyses, remediation planning, issue escalation, and CAPA-related activities for Patient Services / PSP governance, in collaboration with the broader Medical Governance Office and relevant enterprise functions.
- Define and continuously evolve governance standards for digital patient services, including patient portals, digital adherence programs, remote monitoring solutions, patient applications, AI-enabled support capabilities, and other technology-enabled patient engagement models, ensuring responsible innovation while protecting patient safety, privacy, trust, and regulatory compliance.
- Bring responsible innovation by introducing reusable tools, digital intake and workflow solutions, governance automation, dashboards, analytics, AI-enabled oversight capabilities, and continuous-improvement practices that improve transparency, efficiency, risk visibility, and governance effectiveness without adding unnecessary bureaucracy.
- Represent the Medical Governance Office in relevant PSP, diagnostic services, patient support, vendor, data/digital, and cross-functional governance discussions, ensuring enterprise governance expectations are clearly understood and practically embedded.
- Capture and share learnings, best practices, and common market needs to strengthen the enterprise governance foundation.
- Serve as the primary Patient Services governance interface to Global Digital/DD&T for digital patient services, patient-facing technologies, digital health solutions, data-enabled support models, and emerging AI-enabled patient engagement capabilities, ensuring governance expectations are integrated across Medical, Quality, Regulatory, Privacy, Cybersecurity, and Digital functions.

Skills and qualifications
- Degree in life sciences, pharmacy, healthcare management, or related discipline preferred.
- 8+ years of experience in Medical Affairs, Patient Services / Patient Solutions, PSP governance, Medical Operations, Quality, Compliance, Risk Management, or related functions within biopharma or healthcare.
- Strong understanding of PSPs, Patient Services, diagnostic services, patient support models, patient journey needs, vendor-enabled healthcare services, and global/local execution realities.
- Experience developing or implementing governance frameworks, standards, SOPs, control models, risk assessments, audit-readiness activities, dashboards, or cross-functional operating models.
- Experience working across multiple countries, regions, or markets with varied maturity levels and regulatory environments preferred.

Competencies
- Ability to translate enterprise governance expectations into simple, usable tools and guidance that support local implementation without adding unnecessary complexity.
- Strong understanding of digital health ecosystems, patient-facing technologies, patient data governance, privacy requirements, platform governance, and emerging AI-enabled patient engagement capabilities.
- Strong governance, risk-based thinking, and systems-thinking capability, with the ability to convert complexity into practical enterprise standards and decision tools.
- Excellent cross-functional leadership, communication, influence, and stakeholder-management skills across cultures and seniority levels.

title: Nurse specialist in dementia care
description:
To primarily provide holistic, evidence-based best practice care to a private individual relating to all her needs in positive person-centred manner. These needs currently include having a diagnosis of dementia, age-related frailties and any other issues or health co-morbidities that may arise.

Essentially the post-holder will be required to:

- Assesses; plans, develops and implements programmes of care; provides advice; maintains associated records either manually or digitally;
- Carry out nursing procedures as required and in concordance with clinical guidelines;
- Provide clinical supervision to other staff.

The post holder will direct, coordinate and supervise, where appropriate, the work of other staff to promote best practice in relation to the care of the client with dementia. In the absence of the team leader, the post holder will provide cover to ensure effective delivery of care to the client. Any issues should be raised with the line manager.

QUALIFICATIONS / Essential requirements

- Swiss or EU passport (or Swiss working permit holder)
- Registered Nurse with valid NMC registration or European/Swiss equivalent.
- Nursing degree or equivalent.
- Best Practice in Dementia Training completion or working towards, ability to undertake this.
- Willingness to undergo specific dementia training ie Best Practice in Dementia Care, delivered in English.
- Additional qualifications in relation to dementia and dementia related topics including stress and distress training, meaningful activity, Sage and Thyme.
- Understanding of the Newcastle Model and/or PINCHME model of behaviour assessment.
- Willingness to develop dementia knowledge as part of CPD either independently or as provided by the Organisation.
- Specialist dementia qualification or additional studies in related areas.
- Understanding behaviour as a communication and good knowledge of non-pharmacological interventions and strategies.
- Experience in End of Life Care / Develop relevant clinical skills to address any developing co-morbidities and end-of-life care

QUALIFICATIONS / Additional requirements (may be utilised to benefit LHS)

- Moving and Handling Trainer
- Beauty/Massage Therapy
- Meaningful Activity

LANGUAGE / Essential

- Ability to communicate effectively using English.    English as first language (ideally mother tongue). Local dialect to client – Central Scotland.
- Excellent written communication in English.
- Due to the nature of FTL Dementia the language centres of the brain are affected. The inability to communicate effectively has a detrimental affect on LHS and their quality of life, increasing stress and distressed behaviour.

EXPERIENCE

Minimum 5 years’ experience working with people with dementia.
    
PERSONAL SKILLS AND ABILITIES

- Demonstrate excellent team working skills with the ability to work using own initiative.
- Effective listening, communication, and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work with people and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
- Excellent time management skills.
- Working knowledge of basic technology.    
- Teaching skills for junior members of staff, family and other professionals.

SPECIFIC JOB REQUIREMENTS

- Being able to commit to working a shift pattern based in Buckinghamshire, UK and Switzerland for extended periods of time (preferably 10-14 days) / Necessity to travel with the client in UK.
- Unsociable hours are included this comes in the form of a sleepover arrangement alternating nights with another member of staff for the period of time ‘on shift’.
- May involve accompanying client to and from other venues as part of the duties.
- Be able to conduct and present themselves in a manner appropriate to the social standing of the client.
- Confidentiality must be always maintained both in line with NMC requirements as well as organisationally given the nature of the employer – a confidentiality agreement will be provided separately.
- Understanding the culture local to the client and family as dementia progresses earlier years are more prevalent and a lack of awareness or understanding can cause increased stress and distress which could lead to unnecessary pharmacological interventions.    
- Housekeeping is also a key aspect of this position.

description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more athttps://www.jnj.com/.



About Orthopaedics

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments.

Are you passionate about improving and expanding the possibilities of Orthopaedics? Ready to join a team that’s reimagining how we heal? Our Orthopaedics teams help keep more than 6 million people moving each year while delivering clinical and economic value to surgeons and healthcare systems. Our teams build solutions for joint reconstruction; trauma and craniomaxillofacial; sports, extremities, and elective foot and ankle; spine; and robotics and digital surgery.

Your unique talents will help patients on their journey to wellness. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/medtech



Strategic Account Manager Orthopaedics - Johnson & Johnson

Western Part of Switzerland

Are you passionate about making a tangible difference in healthcare? Do you thrive on building strong relationships and driving growth? We are seeking a Senior Strategic Account Manager to join our sales team, drive market expansion, and deliver innovative surgical solutions to our customers. This role anchors Johnson & Johnson’s go-to-market strategy, emphasizing long-term partnerships and measurable value for patients. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to elevate customer outcomes and fuel sustainable business growth. If you’re a strategic thinker with a proven track record in key account management, we’d love to hear from you.



Responsibilities

Strategic Account Management is an essential part of the future business strategy for the Johnson & Johnson companies. It is how we will go to market as an Orthopaedics organization and will be critical to our future growth plans. With this approach to our non-clinical customers, we can demonstrate the long-term value of partnership and working with Johnson & Johnson, most importantly, our impact on patient care.

In the role as Strategic Account Manager you will report to the Lead of the Strategic Account Management for Orthopaedics and be responsible for developing mutually beneficial long-term partnerships with clinical and non-clinical partners in a given number of designated key accounts.

In conjunction with the Business Units, you will develop and lead the account strategy to drive additional profitable sales and market share growth within Hospital, Hospital Groups & Group Purchasing Organizations.

Together with the clinical team, you will coordinate and support the proposal development process, presenting opportunities and risks along with their implications to the required levels of management.

As key driver of our Value Based Health Care Strategy you will lead negotiations for commercial agreements and coordinate their execution across care centers, in collaboration with the Business Unit and Shared Functions (Pricing, Services & Solutions, HEMA, etc.).

You will be the representative of Johnson & Johnson Orthopaedics for the commercial partners in strategic accounts.



Qualifications

Master’s degree in Business Administration or relevant field is an advantage.

Several years of clinical experience in a Sales Manager or Key Account Manager role, with proven experience in managing non-clinical partnerships.

Deep understanding of the healthcare market and the local regulatory/policy environment; adept at identifying short-term and long-term factors impacting the business.

Experience in contract negotiations and deal structuring.

Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills in French to professionally represent Johnson & Johnson’s MedTech in the country; strong English skills (written and spoken) are required; proficiency in a second official language is preferred.

German language skills in writing and speaking are a plus.

Strong negotiation skills, high self-confidence, courage, and conviction.

Analytical and strategic thinker with solid business acumen.

Project management capabilities with the ability to lead complex initiatives involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.

Strong team spirit and collaborative mindset.



Johnson & Johnson announced plans to separate our Orthopaedics business to establish a standalone Orthopaedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 4 to 9 months, subject to legal requirements, including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals.

Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans.In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by DePuy Synthes at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes.

NGS Scientist (single\-cell and spaital Omics)
==============================================







For our Client, a leading pharmaceutical company based in Basel, we are looking for a motivated NGS Scientist\-







Single\-cell and spatial omics technologies are transforming biomedical research by enabling deep characterization of complex biological systems at unprecedented resolution. These technologies provide critical insights into cellular heterogeneity, disease mechanisms, therapeutic responses, and translational biology.



We are seeking a highly motivated Scientist / Associate Scientist to join a cutting\-edge genomics platform team focused on single\-cell sequencing, spatial transcriptomics, and next\-generation sequencing (NGS) applications. The successful candidate will work at the interface of molecular biology, genomics, and translational research, supporting the development and implementation of innovative omics technologies that accelerate scientific discovery and therapeutic innovation.







Key Responsibilities



* Develop, optimize, and implement advanced NGS\-based workflows with a focus on:
* Single\-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA\-seq)
* Spatial transcriptomics
* Multi\-omics and multimodal profiling approaches
* Independently perform molecular biology experiments and troubleshoot complex workflows.
* Execute sample processing, nucleic acid extraction, PCR/qPCR, library preparation, sequencing, and quality control activities.
* Generate, analyze, and document experimental results with a high level of scientific rigor.
* Work with challenging sample types including FFPE tissues, primary samples, and low\-input materials.
* Collaborate closely with bioinformatics and cross\-functional research teams to interpret sequencing datasets and derive biological insights.
* Ensure generation of high\-quality, FAIR\-compliant data.
* Present scientific findings, protocols, and recommendations to internal stakeholders.
* Contribute to continuous innovation and enhancement of platform capabilities.






Required Qualifications



* Master's degree in Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Life Sciences, Genomics, or a related discipline.
* 1\-3 years of industry or relevant research experience in genomics or molecular biology.
* Hands\-on experience with Next\-Generation Sequencing (NGS) workflows.
* Strong expertise in:
* DNA/RNA extraction
* PCR and qPCR
* NGS library preparation
* Molecular biology laboratory techniques
* Experience handling clinical or challenging biological samples such as FFPE tissue, tumor specimens, or low\-input samples.
* Proven ability to independently design, execute, analyze, and troubleshoot experiments.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
* Fluent English.






Preferred Qualifications



* Hands\-on experience with single\-cell sequencing platforms (e.g. 10x Genomics Chromium).
* Experience with spatial transcriptomics and spatial biology technologies (e.g. Visium, Xenium, CosMx, RNAscope).
* Knowledge of transcriptomics, genomics, and multi\-omics approaches.
* Experience with assay development, method optimization, and technology implementation.
* Familiarity with basic bioinformatics analyses and interpretation of sequencing datasets.
* Experience in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or translational research environment.






What We're Looking For



We are particularly interested in candidates who combine strong wet\-lab genomics expertise with a passion for emerging technologies such as single\-cell sequencing and spatial biology. Successful candidates are curious, innovative, collaborative, and excited about applying cutting\-edge omics technologies to advance translational research and therapeutic discovery.

title: Global Merchandising Head Of Lifestyle & Special Projects
description:
In short
As the Global Merchandising Head Of Lifestyle & Special Projects, you will shape and drive the Global Merchandising strategy across On’s Lifestyle portfolio, spanning both Lifestyle Footwear and Special Projects across Footwear, Apparel and Accessories.
You will own the global range architecture, consumer proposition and tailored assortments, ensuring On delivers the right product, to the right consumer, in the right channel, at the right time and at the right price.
At the heart of this role is creating consumer desirability and brand heat while building a sustainable and scalable Lifestyle business. You will translate On’s global brand and product strategy into compelling assortments that balance commercial performance with premium brand positioning.
You will bring a strong point of view on consumer, product, channel and market opportunity, influencing product briefs and franchise strategies from the earliest stages of development through to seasonal execution and sell-through.
For Special Projects, you will apply the same commercial and consumer lens to build high-impact, culturally relevant and strategically important product stories, using controlled distribution, scarcity and tailored assortments to create demand and strengthen On’s premium positioning.
You will partner closely with Product, Design, Innovation, Brand, Regional Merchandising, Partnership Management, VM and Global and Regional Sales to ensure consumer and market insights translate into differentiated product strategies, global range architecture and commercially successful assortments.

Your mission
Build the Global Lifestyle Merchandising Strategy
- Define and evolve the global merchandising strategy for Lifestyle and Special Projects, translating On’s broader brand and product priorities into clear consumer and commercial strategies.
- Build the global range architecture ensuring an efficient yet compelling Lifestyle proposition.
- Identify opportunities to expand Lifestyle into new consumer segments, channels and categories while protecting On’s premium positioning.
- Develop clear merchandising frameworks that balance consumer desirability, brand heat, commercial opportunity and sustainable profitability.

Drive Product & Franchise Strategy
- Influence product briefs and franchise strategies from concept through to commercialization, ensuring products are rooted in clear consumer and market opportunities.
- Establish clear roles for hero, core, growth and incubation franchises, ensuring the portfolio evolves with consumer demand.
- Identify when franchises should be scaled, reset, repositioned or exited based on consumer and commercial signals.

Own Global Range & Assortment Excellence
- Build seasonal range plans across Lifestyle and Special Projects, translating global strategy into detailed SKU-level line plans.
- Build consumer-right tailored channel assortments globally, balancing global consistency with regional and account-specific opportunities.
- Provide a clear point of view on product flow, colour needs, depth, price and channel distribution to maximize seasonal performance.
- Ensure global and regional teams are aligned on the range strategy while allowing appropriate market localization.

Lead Special Projects
- Own the global merchandising strategy for Special Projects, working project-by-project to define the consumer proposition, range, targets, distribution and commercial strategy.
- Develop clear scarcity and allocation frameworks to balance brand heat with commercial opportunity.
- Partner closely with Product, Design and Brand to bring strategically important innovations and collaborations to market.
- Ensure Special Projects acts as an incubator for future Lifestyle franchises, consumer insights and new business opportunities.
- Set sell-through, volume, NS and productivity targets and ensure the range is structured to deliver against them.

Drive Commercial Performance
- Own global seasonal targets and commercial KPIs across Lifestyle and Special Projects.
- Identify commercial risks and opportunities early and drive cross-functional actions to address them.
- Use performance data, consumer signals and market intelligence to continuously refine the global range strategy.

Your story
- 8+ years of experience within premium sportswear, luxury fashion or streetwear with significant experience owning global or multi-market businesses.
- Strong people leader with the ability to build, develop and inspire a high-performing global merchandising team.
- Proven track record of building global merchandising strategies and commercial plans across multiple channels and markets.
- Deep understanding of Lifestyle and sneaker culture, with a strong instinct for what will create consumer relevance and brand heat.
- Commercially strong, with the ability to balance brand aspiration, consumer desirability and financial performance.
- Highly comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed global environment, with strong executive presence and the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
- A strategic thinker who can move seamlessly between 5-year vision and SKU-level detail.
- Exceptional relationship builder who can connect Product, Design, Innovation, Brand, Merchandising, Sales and Regional teams around a common consumer and commercial ambition.
- A resilient, entrepreneurial leader who thrives in ambiguity, embraces change and proactively builds solutions in a high-growth environment.
- Data-led but consumer obsessed, able to combine quantitative insights with strong product and cultural intuition.

Meet the team
On’s Global Merchandising Team sits at the center of Product, Brand and Commercial Strategy, ensuring we create and deliver the right product to the right consumer, in the right market, at the right time and at the right scale.
As the Global Merchandising Head of Lifestyle (Inline) & Special Projects, you will lead the merchandising strategy for one of On’s key future growth opportunities, working across global and regional teams to build a consumer-led, commercially sustainable and culturally relevant Lifestyle business.
You will be a key voice in shaping not only what we sell, but where On plays, how we build demand and how we scale the Lifestyle business globally
